Laa-Laa makes up a lovely song about all the things she sees on her walk across Teletubbyland. Afterwards, she sings a song to Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po. They sing the song together and watch a children's choir sing in Tummy Tales.
Tee's a growing monkey and is getting quite heavy, however some days he just wants to be carried, all day.
Black and White arrive in Colourland. Learn about two colours that are very different from the other Colourblocks.
Bingo is in the music shop with mum when she discovers an electronic drum kit and some headphones.

Bing and Sula are painting in the garden. When Bing cleans his brush and accidentally knocks the water over, he goes to fill it up from the garden tap. But he turns the water on too fast, making the hose whoosh up into a big snake of water that covers Bing and Sula in wet paint! Flop shows Bing how to turn the tap on slowly.
Tao can't go on with his circus performance, so there are going to be some disappointed fans, unless Bo agrees to do all the acts for him - with some help from Mojo's tops!

The Squirrels are confused when they see Duggee sitting on a ball because they like to use it differently. Duggee is quick to explain to the Squirrels that there is no right or wrong way to play and that everyone is different.

After learning that Duggee is making his yearly batch of blueberry jam, a tradition passed on from his great-aunt, the Squirrels decide to spread the news. They learn that people can be told about, read about, hear about or watch news.
When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey.
Bluey wants to help Dad make Bingo's birthday cake, but first she must put away her toys. But nothing can tempt her to clean up, until Dad drops the cake.
Kym's first challenge is in Singapore. Can she find the G.O Star before Glitch?
Peter and his friends set out to taste the sweetest dandelions in the world, only to find that they're protected by the meanest character in the entire valley!
The Octonauts expand their exploration beyond the sea and onto land. With new rides and new friends, they are prepared to protect any habitats and animals at risk on land or underwater.
Five's new smoothie café is open! Can the Numberblocks get the orders right?
Meet Gold and Silver who sparkle and shine!
On Dress Up Day, Love Monster goes as a superhero but realises his fun might be ruining everyone else's.
Robert, Little Monster, Cat and Cherry get a chance to audition to join YolanDa and her house band, but when YolanDa arrives, they all get too nervous to play.
Throw some shapes with King Tiger. Your shape could be a square, a triangle, a circle, a hexagon, or a heptagon.

Bing, Pando, Flop and Padget are waiting for the bus to the seaside! Bing's frustrations grow when Pando jumps on first to 'bloop' his ticket, pushes Bing's hand to 'bloop' his too and sits in the window seat first. To make matters worse, the bus breaks down, making Bing very disappointed! But the bus driver lets Bing sit in the driver's seat, beep the horn and use her special driver's ticket activation card!
Dee encourages a friend to say 'flower' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a pink flower and a yellow flower, a frilly flower and a silly squirty flower.
Tralala finds the house too noisy until she joins the dust bunnies' rock band.
A magical key unlocks a door to some giant-sized fun.
Lou eats too much sugar and runs amok at a poetry recital.

The Twirlywoos see a lady and her father sitting in deckchairs at the beach. The lady insists that her dad puts his sun hat on but when he thinks she isn't looking, he takes it off. The Twirlywoos pop up behind her dad and take his hat off again.
Justin goes shoe shopping with his friend. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble visits Shopkeeper Tumble at The Shop with the Lot for a pair of new red boots!
The Teletubbies bounce on the Tubby Bouncy. Po bounces as high as a cloud, then Laa-Laa bounces higher, Dipsy bounces even higher and Tinky Winky bounces highest of all.

Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Roman, Rose-may, Eliza, Theo, Joseph, George, Gracie and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone's bags are oranges which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate oranges inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby!
Elsie plays I Spy whilst on a beach walk with Mohamoud.
Maddie and Triggs help Nana and Dado care for a very special family tree.

Rebecca has a new pet plant called Stan. Murphy is very pleased to meet Stan - he loves plants and jungles. This gives him a monster idea for the first make - a terrifically tropical bug made from a reused plastic bottle. The Mini Monsters make bottle fish, and Rebecca's great aunt makes a silly plant for her pet bug. The Recycling Express brings some egg boxes to the attic - just the thing Murphy needs to make a snippy snappy egg box crocodile. The Tiny Helpers add the teeth and eyes.

Raa Raa and all his friends are finding out about different animals. Raa Raa wants a partner to dance a noisy stompy dance with. All the animals have their own way of dancing, apart from Zebby who says she is too shy to dance, or is she?
While camping in the bush, Bluey makes a new friend who doesn't speak the same language.
Meet Duggee, a big lovable dog who runs a club for pre-schoolers that inspires children to have fun, be energetic, and - most of all - to do things!

George wants to find out all about prawns. Chantelle meets some new friends at the beach and heads to the rock pools to search for prawns, whilst Rory goes to the north of Scotland to meet a local expert at the harbour.
Eden and Ava set up a beauty salon and make their very own face mask mixture. Dad pops along for a beauty treatment. Later, the family heads to the park for a game of hide-and-seek.

Jen and Small are off to a disco, but they need to finish dusting before they can go. Cinderella visits the café, Small flies off to see how pumpkins grow, and the chefs make pumpkin slippers for their magical friend.

Kika is a golden Labrador and a guide dog for her owner Dr Amit, who is blind. She is trained to use her super sight to help him do as many things as he can by himself. Together, they make the best team. Kika needs to help Dr Amit catch a train to the city. First, they must walk to the station. Kika knows the way like the back of her paw, but there are some important things they must do along the way.
Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet Chinese giant salamanders and Alaotran gentle lemurs.
Midwife Marley shows how her foetal heart scanner can pick up the sound that a baby's heart makes inside its mummy's tummy.
The club welcomes Pepper and a magical Book Corner. When Waffle cannot join the bouncy castle fun, the after-schoolers make sure everyone feels included.
When Bernie has an accident and manages to break his shell, Oona and Silky volunteer to dive to the depths to find him a new one. However, it proves to be quite the challenge to find one suitable.

Stripes and Toad see a beautiful sunrise and decide to write a song about it together, but Stripes wants the song to be rocky, while Toad wants it to be slower. When they fall out and go off to write their own songs separately, Yukee tries to help them become friends again and create one song together.

Lu promises to keep a secret but, in her excitement, tells Barnaby, who also promises to keep the secret but tells Biba. Lu gets mad at Barnaby for blabbing but learns that she can't be upset with someone for doing something she has also done.
Cherry asks the Piggies to make a relaxing bench for Brian to rest on. Wilf, self-appointed relaxation expert, offers to help. The bench ends up being anything but relaxing - it goes haywire!
Are you sitting comfortably? Then we shall begin a bedtime story all about the first five numberblocks. Learn about numbers one, two, three, four, and five.
W wants to be a superhero, like his superhero, X. However, saving Alphablocks is not as easy as it looks, especially when they don't need saving, until the mighty Box Man arrives.
Ben and his friends bake cakes while Mr Tumble gets ready for a party.
Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po enjoy Tiddlytubbies Songtime. Then it is time for Teletubbies Songtime. The Teletubbies sing solo before singing all together.

Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how hedges play an important role in the environment. They find out that hedges are a shelter for all types of animals and insects, and that they can help reduce air and noise pollution. On the way, they look closely at what's living in a hedge, before pretending to be animals looking for a hedge to hide in.
Maddie is at a train museum, finding out how train tracks work by moving trains from one track to another to get to the right place. She also gets to see how the signal box works.

Motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that work in sustainable forests. Grace helps drive a tree harvester, shows off a tree-planting machine and then gathers logs with a tree-forwarding machine.

It's Miss Gerrard's birthday, and the children plan a surprise party for her. Felicity and Coen are the chefs. They're in charge of baking and decorating a delicious birthday cake, with help from Mrs Bailey. Theo and Jasper are making a beautiful birthday crown for Miss Gerrard to wear, and have asked Mrs Hussain to help them. With everything ready, it's time for the surprise party!
The Octonauts recruit a shape-shifting mimic octopus to help them recover an important vial of medicinal algae from a moray eel's lair.
Peter and his friends try to find the perfect place to eat the radishes they took from Mr McGregor's garden. Unfortunately, there is a radish robber on their tails.
Meet Duggee, a big lovable dog who runs a club for pre-schoolers that inspires children to have fun, be energetic, and - most of all - to do things!
Nugget plays big sister to a kid penguin for the summer. But when her hyper-energetic plans for fun activities prove unpopular, Pancake suggests an alternative approach.
When Supertato discovers that Evil Pea and the Mini Peas are sleepwalking through the supermarket, he tries to get them back to bed.
It's the Ducklings' big day of outdoor activities, but Weasy is too tired after staying up all night playing video games. Can he find a way to wake up and come through for the Ducklings?
It's secret agent time when Mojo and Bo think Didi the tractor is up to something fishy. But can these two supersecret spies follow her without being spy-spotted?
Zog and the doctors become teachers for the day, looking after the little dragons.
PC Plum jumps to conclusions when he hears about an upcoming volcanic eruption. But little does he know, it's Ava's science project that's set to fizzle in a safe experiment.
Doug's mum, Zoe, brings surprises for the Brooklyn-Bells, but Waffle is sad because Doug is going to stay with her for a few days. Mrs Hobbs watches Waffle with new spy equipment.
Rafi's breakfast wish causes kitchen chaos when she wakes up early to surprise her dads.

JoJo needs to find different-coloured leaves to complete her nature tick-book, but she can't find a green one. What will she do? Luckily, Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan that involves a special leaf rubbing!
Sarah needs some new shoes but picks out a very unusual pair.
Mother Clanger has grown a beautiful new flower, but when Tiny, Small and Major see it they realise it is the source of the horrible smell they have been experiencing.
MeMo helps BaBa play a game that involves matching shapes on Planet BeddyByes.
The Tombliboos' trousers get mixed up all over the place, in the Ninky Nonk, in the Pinky Ponk. No matter how often the Tombliboos change their trousers back, it happens all over again.
Dillie Dally sails in a beautiful balloon across Planet Dream to the Hushabirds and their Hushabird Queen, high in the sky.
JB Gill reads a bedtime story about how families can come in lots of different shapes and sizes.

The first seller today is Amy, with two very decorative perfume bottles she hopes will entice the dealers to spend. Next, Emma has brought in an old tin box that has a clever feature. Both decorative and surprising, she hopes it will have the dealers reaching for their cash.

Celebrity TV couple Fern Britton and Phil Vickery take a roadtrip around Devon with antiques experts Mark Stacey and James Braxton. Paired up and armed with a classic car and £400 each, the teams scour antique shops for buys that will make a profit at auction in Crewkerne, Somerset. On their journey Fern finds out more about crime writer Agatha Christie and Phil goes back to the basics of bread making. All profits made go to `Children in Need'.

Presenter Amanda Byram, actor Adam Thomas, dancer Brendan Cole and newsreader Naga Munchetty all try to take home thousands of pounds for their chosen charities.

What did the armchair critics make of 'Adolescence', 'Tribe with Bruce Parry', and 'Bad Dog Academy?' Also, 'Tempting Fortune', 'The Yorkshire Vet', 'Million Dollar Secret' and 'ITV News (Greenland/Wrestling)'.
Gordon checks into the luxurious Lakeview Hotel on Lake Chelan, Washington, where the bedrooms are empty and the hotel's restaurant and ice-cream parlour are failing.

The illegitimate son of an African slave and a French plantation owner, Joseph Bologne rises to improbable heights in French society as a celebrated violinist-composer and fencer, complete with a love affair and falling out with Marie Antoinette.
Homer and Bart go for help when the Simpsons' camper breaks down in the woods. Just when things couldn't get any worse, Homer is mistaken for Bigfoot.
Homer becomes "Towmer" in his new job as Springfield's tow truck driver. However, the power of towing goes straight to his head and the townsfolk turn on him.
Marge finds herself in the midst of a bank robbery, but her persuasive chat convinces robber Dwight David Diddlehopper to give himself up.

While Carla is on maternity leave, Sam and Rebecca hire two temporary waitresses: Annie, Carla's daughter-in-law, and Laurie, who was recommended by Mr Drake. Annie repeatedly flirts with Sam to spite her unemployed husband.

Mr Drake invites Sam and Rebecca for a weekend on his yacht. Rebecca is still interested in Mr Drake, and Sam brings his fling along. Meanwhile, Woody gives customers, including Norm and Cliff, five free rounds of beer as their birthday gifts.
Doug loses his best friend and companion when Carrie leaves the garage door open overnight. She does her best to make amends, but will it be enough?
Arthur accidentally hears Doug call him a 'Demented Old Circus Monkey'. So Doug tries to make it up to him by taking him to a Mets game. Trouble ensues.
When Doug and Carrie go on holiday to celebrate their anniversary, they decide to take Deacon and Kelly, which ends up being a big mistake.

Frank gets injured before going on a Caribbean cruise with Marie, so Ray stands in for him, sharing a tiny cabin with his mother, and being mistaken for her lover. Back home, Robert has to look after Frank.
Doug Heffernan (Kevin James) comes over to hang out with Ray while Debra and the kids are away for the weekend.
Ray employs questionable tactics in an attempt to get to the front of the queue to meet the New York ⚾ [MLB] Mets 1969 'miracle' team at the Baseball Hall of Fame.
Frasier hires a temporary replacement for a holidaying Roz, but the woman soon begins to take over his radio show.
Niles' new girlfriend pushes him and Frasier into competition for a coveted position in their wine club.
Frasier and Roz discover they have a lot in common when they are forced to bunk together at a convention.
Frasier's agent Bebe (Harriet Sansom Harris) becomes his unlikely co-host during a temporary stint on a TV talk show.
Gordon visits Boardwalk 11, a Los Angeles gastropub and karaoke bar, where the late-night singing entertainment has become more appealing than the dining experience.

In Shropshire, Alan and Catherine take on another huge project. In Humberside, Lucy and Seb are finally watertight and turn their attentions to creating a main bedroom. And Rosi and Antony have made a life-changing move to a Georgian farmhouse.

Northern Irish couple Seán and Áine plan the Salty Shamrock pub's annual St Puppies Day dog show. Yorkshireman Nick struggles to light his Brits-only barbecue. And Laura's Olympic equestrian career may be over before it's begun.
Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Konnie Huq in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against vowels, consonants and numbers.

Laura Hamilton is on Portugal's Costa da Caparica helping Caron and Ivo hunt a holiday home that might become permanent. They have a budget of £300,000 to find a property with enough space for Ivo's five motorcycles and Caron's collection of clothes.

Kevin and Anna from Buckinghamshire are fusing French and British heritage to revive a forgotten rural estate. In central Italy, young couple Lucie and Jerry are more determined than ever to make their earthquake-damaged borgo habitable.

The competition begins at Lodge Duxford in Cambridgeshire, where hosts Lucy and Craig hope their boutique hotel will tick all the boxes. A trip to see some vintage RAF planes sends group relations soaring.

The first host in north Wales, 24-year-old spray tan artist Saffron, is hoping to wow her guests with a Vegas casino-themed night of glitz and glam. She gambles everything by making all her food from scratch for her guests.

Jenny and keen golfer Emrys dream of owning a holiday home in Nerja on the Costa del Sol. Laura Hamilton shows them five fabulous options for their budget of £220k, including an in-demand apartment and a tempting traditional house.
Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

Jamie Oliver makes parmesan-kissed pork fillets with crispy prosciutto and sage served with gorgeous greens, and spicy chicken curry with vibrant veggies, served with fluffy rice, poppadoms and bashed pistachios for a crunchy topping.
Toxic ideologies infiltrate Helen and Steve's relationship.

34-year-old Sunny is rushed to Resus with multiple stab wounds to his chest and back. Doctors are concerned about why 87-year-old Eunice is coughing up blood. And 15-year-old Tyler has injured his foot playing football.

When a man lashes out at two female paramedics, they're forced to call for help. A man who has severe abdominal pains is reluctant to go to hospital. And a woman has fallen at home, cutting her knee to the bone.
Dermot, Sam and Osi host a clash between two of the NFL's historic franchises in Arlington as the 🏈 [NFL] Cowboys and the 🏈 [NFL] 49ers repeat their classic battles from the 90s.

A woman makes a desperate attempt to frame her friend right in front of deputies; a driver's assortment of containers raises some questions; a man in possession of a stolen truck insists that his friend is the one at fault.
We search the world to bring you the most innovative home and garden must-haves. So, sit back, relax and discover something new.
We explore the surprising origins of the New Year's and Birthday Honours, how royals contribute - and recover - from scandals, and the defunct role of the royal jester.

Practice director Guy has complex thyroid surgery to perform on a much-loved elderly cat, Scratchy. Meanwhile, practice director Ken is called to a farm where a cow is struggling to give birth to twins, extremely rare in cattle.

Fiona treats Aslan, a four-year-old German Shepherd with one of the worst cases of an anal infection she's ever seen. Meanwhile, Katie is heading back to the practice for an emergency: a pregnant ewe has fallen and become stranded on her back.
When Sid Swashbuckle and his pirate pooch, Arrby, swipe the PAW Patrol's prestigious award, Ryder and the pups set out to recover it.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.
Tweedy uses an old nail brush to clean up Fluff's paw prints, and Fluff is intimidated by the brush.
When Martin exaggerates what his home was like in a very fanciful way, Odo and Doodle try to rebuild Forest Camp in the style of Martin's fantastic descriptions.

Thomas's friend Merlin the stealth engine comes to Sodor for the first time and thinks that nobody else can see him when he shuts his eyes. After Percy hears everybody talking about the 'invisible' engine, he wonders why he has not seen him.

It's the Pontypandy Animal Parade at Annie's Farm. Peter and Norman want to join in by rounding Lambykins and Woolly but end up losing the lamb in a gully. After Peter falls into it as well, the rescue team try to save the pair.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.

When Pip finds a 'Lucky Stick', he and Posy use it to save Fox Boy's ice cream, rescue Zac's hat, and retrieve Jamila's favourite conker, but the stick loses a leaf or twig or hook each time it does something lucky.
Paddington does not have a hobby like all the Browns, but Mrs Brown finds out what Paddington is good at.
When a baby goose hatches in Humdinger's lair, the little bird mistakes the mayor for his new mama!
The town Chilli Cookaroo is threatened when City Hall's roof starts to cave in; luckily, the pups know just how to fix it.
Peppa and her family have been on a trip to a mountain beauty spot. When Daddy Pig loses the car keys down a drain, Mr Bull offers to find them with his digger.
The school roof is leaking! So, the playgroup hosts a floating market to raise money. All the money is collected into a jar which Madame Gazelle drops into the lake!
When Tia misses the Spinny Star, Tim tries to recreate it for her.
Stink's acting very mysteriously. Why does he keep running off and howling out to sea? What can he sense that Stan and Gran can't? They have to find out!
The pups must help salmon get to the ocean and also need to rescue Alex who gets stuck on top of a dam.
The Cadets get hands-on at Yorkshire Wildlife Park, tossing fish to playful sea lions, tidying the tapirs' enclosure and preparing a tasty lunch for the red pandas.

Milo and his friends are left in charge of Shona's "Flowers and Petals" flower shop, but they soon run out of flowers for Mycroft's surprise party. Using the right type of plant for each occasion will save the situation.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.
Holly and Ben think Gaston the Ladybird is sad so they try and cheer him up by tidying his cave, but Gaston liked his cave just as it was, all messy and untidy.
Join Kemi for a thrilling story of a boy and his grandad who embark on a journey across the sea in a makeshift boat as they search for the boy's lost toy penguin.
Start the day with a dose of hard-hitting debate, your phone calls and a little fun - all driven by Jeremy's unique style.
Two of 5's much-loved faces team up to focus on the issues that matter most to viewers - with your opinions front and centre.
Round-up of the day's headlines from around the world.
Matt looks at the big news stories developing during the day and offers help and advice to save you money and make your lives a little easier.

Thanks to some holiday magic, Emma gets to experience two different Christmases — one where she stays in the city and celebrates with a new crush and his friends, and one where she returns home for all the traditions with her family.
Under the guise of a journalist, Campbell has a chance to get to know her biological father for the first time — without him ever knowing who she really is.
Join Dan Walker and the team for the news that matters to you.
Michael spends a packed weekend on the island of Sicily, dining with a Duchess, toasting a Hollywood legend and investigating the island's murderous links to the Mafia.
A pair of potential car thieves are chased by pursuit units and drones, then nicked by police canine Rocky and the firearms squad. There's also a report of a man stealing fuel.

A biker cop must give life-saving treatment to a seriously injured motorbike rider. Cops hunt a man suspected of threatening another driver with a hammer. But they have no registration plate for the car.
After a moped rider is stabbed 13 times in a daylight attack on Easter Sunday, armed officers quickly stop the getaway car - but detectives must build a case without the weapon.

It's midnight on a quiet residential side street, and five men in a car are violently ambushed. With unprecedented access to the West Midland's Major Crime Unit, we follow investigators racing against time to track suspects and uncover the truth.

South Wales Police CSI and Major Crime detectives investigate after an elderly woman's body is found in a freezer at the home she shares with her son. Did he murder his mother and place her in the freezer?

Featuring music performances from chart sensation Olly Murs, 80s comeback king Rick Astley and stand-up comedy from Irish rising star Al Porter. Also, double gold medal-winning swimmer Rebecca Adlington hands over her phone in Celebrity Send to All.

Criminally funny clips including bad drivers, vigilante OAPs, and a mugging by a marsupial!
Illegal idiocy including a law-breaking bride and a thief holding up a shop using a banana!
The guys compete head-to-head doing and saying whatever the other guys tell them while posing as physical therapists, then pitch some ridiculous ideas for TV show hosts.
The jokers thrill a live theatre audience with holiday-themed games and compete to determine who will make the best Santa. The hair-raising punishment is almost too much for the Jokers to bear.
The guys compete in taxis, doing and saying what the guys tell them to, then try to enlist people into helping them make messes at a grocery store. The punishment involves monster trucks.
Charlie and Laura crash a party attended by Michael Caine.
Charlie rents Caroline's cottage to an aspiring actress.
Sabrina is torn between attending Harvey's big game and helping Josh study for his big exam. Meanwhile, Hilda and Zelda hire a band of pirates to clean house.
Sabrina zaps on a skin cream to appear more mature after college-guy Josh shoots down a romance because of her age, but the fast-acting lotion ends up being a rapid-aging potion.
Consumed with guilt over kissing Josh, Sabrina tries to get Harvey to forgive her without having to say she is sorry.
Sabrina and Harvey's plans for a romantic ski weekend are thwarted when they are trapped in a snowstorm with Brad.
When Raymond lies and tells Debra that he's already bought her an incredibly thoughtful Christmas present, he frantically tries to figure out what to get her.
Frank must make amends with his granddaughter, Ally, when she catches him stealing food at the supermarket.
When Ray's friend, Andy, gets a job booking guests for a local sports radio show, Ray offers to appear as a guest, only to find out that the show's host, Jerry Musso, hates him.
Robert finally decides to propose to Amy. Robert confides his decision to Raymond, and then convinces Ray to accompany him to meet Amy's ultra-conservative parents.
Al Murray returns as the hilarious, irreverent and hugely entertaining Pub Landlord.

Ross is elated that the university library contains his doctoral dissertation, but he is shocked to discover that it is located in a remote corner frequently used by students having sex. Elsewhere, the tables are turned on Joey when Erin is the one to just want sex and not a relationship.

Joey may have ruined Rachel's chances with Tag when he opens his mouth during Thanksgiving dinner, and Phoebe reveals that she has been secretly keeping a cute dog in her room for a few days while its owner is away.

Rachel is dating her assistant, Tag, but they must keep it a secret at work because of the company's anti-dating policy. Her friends warn her that the relationship will only cause her trouble, but just for fun, she becomes more brazen about it.
Ross finds himself looking after Ben and decides to do something special. Since all the Santa costumes have been rented out, Ross dons the holiday armadillo outfit.
He demonstrates why he loves the Olympic opening ceremony and just how romantic a hot bath can be.
Jimmy Carr, GK Barry and Jamali Maddix put more behaviour under the spotlight. There's a witch who spooked their wife, and Wilf from `The Traitors' who invited his mum on his honeymoon.
Irish comedian Dara O Briain performs his newest stand-up show that focuses on the absurdities of modern life, at the Edinburgh Playhouse Theatre in front of a live and sold-out audience.
From romantic dates at Nando's to lads' holidays in Magaluf, British customer service etiquette to having sex at his parents' house, Jack Whitehall dances from one story to another.
Sara Pascoe, Alan Davies, Darren Harriott and sidekick John Kearns welcome Nish Kumar, Chris McCausland, Maisie Adam and Suzi Ruffell to play another round of absurd guessing games.
Mr Bean has a grand day at the hairdresser's, enters Teddy in a pet show and has to find his way off a train when he loses his ticket.

Mr Bean goes to a swimming pool but finds himself terrified of the high diving board, afterwards, he must try several imaginative ways to get out of the car park when he doesn't have enough money to pay. He then demonstrates the proper way to make a sandwich whilst out at the park. Finally, when Mr Bean and his girlfriend go on a date to watch a horror movie he teases her for being scared until the film actually starts.

Chandler and Rachel pig out on a neighbour's cheesecake that was mistakenly delivered to Chandler. They feel bad, but not quite guilty enough to refrain from eating a second one that has also been wrongly delivered.
During their first night together, Rachel and Tag realise they forgot to ship out an important package at the office.

Phoebe's new job as a telemarketer gets off to a tricky start when the first person she calls, an office worker called Earl, tells her he feels unappreciated and wants to kill himself. Phoebe keeps him on the telephone, trying to persuade him otherwise and finally takes the desperate measure of going to his office to convince him to stay alive.

Celebrating Rachel's 30th birthday inspires the friends to reminisce about their own 30th birthdays. Joey got angry with God for breaking their deal, Ross bought himself a sports car in an attempt to recapture his youth, and Monica got blind drunk and embarrassed herself at her surprise party.

Joey accidentally informs a cast member that she will be fired so that his character will get her character's brain, and Ross plans a surprise for Monica and Chandler's wedding - he wants to play the bagpipes.
Monica and Chandler fondly reminisce about London until a startling revelation leaves Chandler floored. Meanwhile, Rachel teaches Ben practical jokes to play on Ross.

Monica regrets telling a fellow bride-to-be about a cheaper bridal shop, and later she has to fight the woman tooth and nail for a unique wedding dress before competing with her to hire Chandler's favourite band for the night. Meanwhile, Joey and Ross discover that they're dating the same girl.

Joey is overjoyed to be nominated for a 'Soapie', the third most prestigious award in daytime dramas. Meanwhile, engaged Monica frets when she realises she will never experience the thrill of a new relationship again, Ross spots Chandler sneaking out of a male strip club, and Phoebe meets a cute guy.

Rachel bumps into a girl she knew in college, and Monica tells everyone they made out once when they were drunk. While making their seating plans for the wedding, Chandler is sad that only 10 percent of the guests are his.
With only four weeks until their wedding, Monica and Chandler try to write their vows. Chandler enlists the boys' help, while Monica does the same with the girls.

Monica convinces a reluctant Chandler to travel to Las Vegas to invite his estranged cross-dressing father to their wedding. Meanwhile, Rachel is furious that she is the only friend who Monica has not allowed to drive the Porsche that her father gave her.
Monica and Chandler prepare for their wedding. Meanwhile, Joey is starring in a movie with a prestigious actor with a spitting problem.
Jimmy, GK Barry and Jamali are passing judgement on some potential wrongdoers. Taking the stand tonight is a romantic gesture fail, and someone who refuses to date if the stars don't align.

Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by Jack Dee, Claudia Winkleman, David O'Doherty and Josh Widdicombe as they thrash out the hot topics of the week by examining surveys, opinion polls and statistics.
Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by Richard Bacon, Gemma Collins, Katherine Ryan and Henning Wehn as they thrash out the hot topics of the week.

Fan email sparks discussion about Karl's previous observation on the dearth of Chinese homeless people. Ricky and Stephen challenge Karl's interpretations of famous sayings and Stephen questions Karl on what he's learned since his New Year's resolution to learn something new every day. Meanwhile, in `Monkey News', Karl relates a story about the NYC fire department enlisting a firefighting monkey.

The remaining members of Danny Ocean's gang regroup to jeopardise the nefarious plans of a businessman who double-crossed one of Danny's old friends. The team plans to ruin the opening of his glitzy Las Vegas casino and hotel by rigging the games and ensuring that every punter goes home with a jackpot.
Live gavel-to-gavel coverage, in-depth legal reporting and expert analysis of America's most important and compelling trials.
Gavel-to-gavel coverage and legal analysis of the nation's most compelling trials.

Following the path from victim to verdict, told from the point of view of the people impacted by the case. Exploring how when it comes to murder, it is rare for there to be no prior connection between the killer and the deceased.

Landlord Bruce Blackwood disappears without a trace in March 2006. Though there is no body, the NYPD is sure this is a homicide and they, along with Bruce's brother Ed, spend the next nine years searching for answers and a killer.

When 19-year-old Tara Sidarovich goes missing from her Punta Gorda home, Florida police consider her a runaway; then her body turns up in a swamp; shocking prison recordings will send detectives on a nationwide hunt for her killer.
Heather Elvis vanishes after calls from an ex-partner, leaving behind a locked car and unanswered questions.
A little-known serial killer terrorises Riverside, California, targeting vulnerable women. As the attacks continue, police face a desperate race to uncover the man responsible.
When a Texas police detective finds his wife dead from a gunshot wound, his fellow detectives work to uncover if her death was an accident, a suicide, or something more sinister.

A car crash on a rural highway leaves one woman dead while her husband walks away unscathed; it appears to be a tragic accident, but one state trooper can't shake the feeling the crash is anything but routine.

Mechanic Ed Postma pulls into a car park at a convenience store to help with a breakdown, not expecting to be shot to death. Persistent police work uncovers a bitter love triangle fuelled by jealousy and rage.

When Derrick Dorsey finds his wife, Kim, dead in their bed, he tells 911 he thinks she's committed suicide. Police find it a strange conclusion to draw since there are bullet holes in the wall and zip ties around Kim's wrists.
Detective Angela Carter takes over the case of a missing teenage girl and wonders if the key to her disappearance could lie shockingly close to home.

When a retired military man runs over a pedestrian, it's up to Lieutenant Joe Kenda to determine if the accident was the result of bad brakes or bad intent. A shooting in a dive bar leads to a quick arrest, but Kenda can't shake feelings of unease.
It appears as though Shaundra Murr has been killed in a hit-and-run accident until Lt. Joe Kenda uncovers evidence that points to a crime of passion.

Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run. A man wanted for carjacking runs out of road during a high-speed chase; an officer climbs on the hood of a car while trying to prevent a fugitive from fleeing.
A man leads police on a high-speed chase in a stolen mail truck; a restaurant owner is arrested after hiding drugs in a takeout box; a pizza delivery guy helps the cops arrest a thief.

A look at some strange arrests from across the country; in Vegas, a man gets naked on top of a poker table; a mum fires multiple rounds at a police station; a citizen dressed in a poop emoji protests in court; and more!

A convicted felon tries to escape while being ushered back to jail; the judge changes a defendant's sentence after she catches him lying in court; a man accused of indecent exposure is held in contempt after swearing at the judge; and more.
Philip Nicholson thought he'd found love. However, 20-year-old Isabella Gossling had other ideas as she lured the vulnerable 22-year-old to his death.
The case of Derrick Bird, a lone gunman who took his own life after a shooting spree in Cumbria that killed 12 people and injured 11 others.

When landscape architect Joanna Yeates disappeared after work Christmas drinks, the nation was gripped by the search for her. Tragedy struck on Christmas day morning when her body was found in a snow-covered lane.
When Molly McLaren finally worked up the courage to leave boyfriend Joshua Stimpson, she found new independence, which riles up a deadly envy within her ex.
Out with friends celebrating, Samantha orders an Uber at 2am. A car pulls up, but it's not her driver. Samantha's death changes ride-share safety laws forever.
Pregnant Monica, finishes her shift at work and goes to meet a friend, but is shot three times on her way there. Two days later, her body is found.
Out celebrating her aunt's birthday at a pub in Arklow, Nadine returns home to her ex where he beats her to the point where she's barely recognisable.
With archive footage, interviews and evidence, police discover the horrific truth at Little Bridge Farm, where Mark Brown's murderous double life comes to light.

In 1989, Richard Mallory is found shot dead in the brush off the side of a Florida motorway, just the first of seven murdered men found in a similar setting; their predator is Aileen Wuornos, a woman fleeing from her troubled past.
Pastors John and Matt Hagee of Hagee Ministries in San Antonio, TX, deliver messages from God's Word, proclaiming the bold truth of His promises.
A biblical and prophetic exploration of Israel, past, present and future. Hosted by Dr. John Tweedie and filmed entirely on location in Israel.

As a cardiologist, evangelist, medical missionary, and author, Samuel Kojoglanian serves the Lord and mankind in the name of Jesus and the power of the Holy Spirit.

The classic Fiat 500 is too expensive, so the team decide to look for a Fiat 126. Will and Gus hunt for neglected cars that they can fix and flip for a profit, but any losses will come out of their own pockets.
The Toyota Sera is a concept car with gull-wing doors and a 50s-style space age glass roof. It's also extremely rare, and the guys find one that's drivable, but not in the way they need.
The team acquire a Triumph Herald that has only had two owners. If the engine, brakes, and gear can be repaired, it will be a gem.
The four-wheel-drive Freelander was once Europe's most popular car. It looks good and runs well, but it failed the inspection on so many points that its owner gave up.
Mechanics Will and Gus go in search of iconic British sports cars for under £1000. They find a classic MG F to refurbish, but the car has many minor problems.
Ted and Justin travel to Market Village Mall in Markham, Ontario, where they are tasked with carefully unlocking mysterious vault doors while the demolition team begins tear down.

Les buys memorabilia from the last remaining Bill Knapp's restaurant for $200, and with a major drop in the price of gold, the store takes a huge financial hit. It's up to the Golds to sell, sell, sell, and make up for the loss.

Les offers to buy a diamond-encrusted Audemars Piguet watch from a customer but asks his watch expert to have a closer look at it first. A heated argument ensues between Ashley and a customer who wants her stolen property back.

Seth brings in a consultant in a desperate bid to increase their retail business in the wake of the gold price crash. But when the outsider calls Les' expertise into question, there may be hell to pay at American Jewelry.

With Les out of commission, Seth and Ashley run the shop as co-managers, but when Seth's decision to cut back on staff leaves Ashley alone on the floor with one too many crazy customers, it's clear that sharing duties just won't work.
When a problem customer crosses the line, Ashley wants to ban him for good, while Seth thinks he's harmless. Also, Les finds himself in the position of commissioning a minute masterpiece.

With Les on the mend, Seth jumps at the chance to manage the store but his new idea to overhaul the lines creates major problems that Ashley is quick to point out. It is unclear how long these growing pains will last.

Les's return proves a shock for Seth and Ashley, who have let profits drop in his absence. Back in charge, Les cuts a deal that could set the shop on fire, but Seth and Ashley think he might be pushing too far, too fast.
When two teens claim that they got scammed by a mystery woman with an inside connection to the shop, Seth brushes them off, but Ashley makes it her job to find out if they are telling the truth.
Ashley's regimental behaviour is concerning for Les who thinks she is being a little too rough on Seth. Seth decides to release some of his frustration with the help of a sledgehammer.

When the computers go down, chaos at American Jewellery runs sky-high. Lines run out the door and the customers are not too happy about waiting around, forcing Ashley to swallow her pride and ask her brother for help.
Seth gets his hands on a baseball allegedly signed by Babe Ruth himself, but when he shells out some major bucks to have it authenticated, it is not a sure thing that his gamble will pay off.
When a cranky customer brings in a rare antique diamond pocket watch, Ashley and Les think it could be worth thousands, but they need verification before shelling out the big bucks.

Henry and Fuzz view an exquisite collection of military and civilian vehicles in Guildford. What will they sell to the drummer from a British rock band?
Henry and Fuzz sail over to the Isle of Wight. They meet Vince, a fanatical collector whose sheds are bursting with British and Japanese bikes.
In Brackley, Henry and Fuzz are overwhelmed by Nick's military collection.
Henry and Fuzz rummage through David's hoard of Italian bikes in Norfolk.
A French museum asks Bruce for help in acquiring an incredibly rare German Panzer 1 tank. He also explores the remains of secret underground Nazi war factories.
Bruce helps a Texan millionaire who wants to collect memorabilia from the Battle of Normandy. He visits farmhouses and museums to find rare items like a 1942 Luger.
A Hollywood blockbuster needs an authentic WWII SAS jeep within two weeks. It's a tight deadline, but Bruce is determined to meet it, as the wartime SAS is a passion of his.
Josh Gates begins his search for extraterrestrial life with a once-in-a-lifetime visit to NASA and an alien-hunting expedition in Chile, where scientists and ufologists are making new discoveries.
Bruce is tasked with finding World War Two spy items that help tell the story of Ian Fleming and James Bond. First, he visits a debonair dealer in London to find some suitable espionage items.
Justin and Emiliano investigate a historical English ship filled with stolen treasures that has long been rumoured to be buried deep in a California desert.
Justin and Emiliano investigate a legendary lost mine in the mountains of Arizona. It is said to contain over 200 million dollars' worth of gold.
Drew and Tee head to Cornwall to visit a brewery in St Austell. Plus, they stop in Penzance and go for a surf in the sea during their South West adventure.
In the Cotswolds, Drew looks around an impressive manor house. Then, he visits a converted chapel in Burnley filled with incredible antiques and a car showroom in Jersey.

New discoveries reveal an astonishing supermassive black hole that was born during the earliest days of the cosmos, and finding out how this giant grew so large so quickly may help to explain the very formation of the universe itself.
In 2014, Malaysia Airlines flight MH370 vanished without a trace. Did it crash and if so, why can't the wreckage be found?
Josh Gates delves into Wild West lore to find Butch Cassidy's missing money. He traces the iconic outlaw's footsteps through Colorado, Utah and Nevada.
Phil and Jess travel to Ireland and the UK to investigate a centuries-old secret society whose most elite members were known to practise satanic worship and ritual sacrifice.

Don Wildman investigates Christopher Columbus' encounter with a fabled sea creature, a death-defying mission atop the nation's tallest building and the abduction of a jazz musician by a notorious gangster.
Don Wildman investigates one of New York City's bravest firefighters, a shipwreck rumoured to contain millions of dollars worth of gold and a storm of biblical proportions.
Once there was life on Mars - but scientists believe a series of devastating mass extinctions transformed a watery planet into a desert.
From a cursed clock in Prague to a death-defying rescue in the snowy Sierra Nevada Mountains, Josh explores six legendary locations that have withstood the test of time.
The technique behind handcrafting espadrilles shoes and the making of prefabricated houses. Also, a look into how they store priceless documents to keep them safe for hundreds of years.
A look into how workers harvest and process the world's toughest and most expensive nut, how one turns lake water into tap water, and the efforts behind holding back thousands of fans at gigs.

The restorers are turning their hands to some old medical equipment. Sculptor Nick revives an antique anatomy model in need of urgent medical attention. Alex turns a scientific specimen cabinet into a pair of attractive cupboards.
Experts investigate to see if the fire on Apollo 1 that killed three astronauts was a cover-up. Was it a tragic accident or part of the moon landing conspiracy?
A team of experts investigate if there was a conspiracy to fake the moon landing, and uncover a secret report on hundreds of Nazis involved in the Apollo space programme.
A series of recent UFO sightings brings Chuck Zukowski's team to Missouri, the home of the 1973 Piedmont lights incident. Armed with new evidence, they tackle whether history is repeating itself.
A Missouri man who claims UFOs are stalking him contacts Chuck and the team for help. Their investigation uncovers a dark secret which may explain this reported activity.
A look at the world's finest oyster knives, the lights transforming the world's most popular sport and how pure diamonds grown in a greenhouse are creating a gemstone revolution.
How do they make cheddar, the world's most popular cheese? How do they breathe life into Resusci Anne, the plastic woman that teaches CPR?
How does Ford produce the ubiquitous white van, the Transit? Plus, how do they ensure the Driza-Bone coat lives up to its name?

We uncover the miraculous feats of engineering which underpin life in the 21st century. How they make wood-burning stoves that bring warmth to the bleak Norwegian winter. Plus, how to build the synthesiser that changed music forever, and more.
After an informant tells of an alien that reportedly escaped from Area 51, Chuck and the team go to Tonopah, Nevada, to investigate whether it still roams the area.
Earth is hit by 100 tons of rock from space every day; most burn up in the atmosphere, but a single rock wiped out the dinosaurs.
When a massive star dies it can direct a blast of radiation that would obliterate all life.
Richard visits the world's tallest building, the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, where his vertical mission includes climbing the biggest lightning conductor in the world.
Richard Hammond travels to the giant Appomattox production platform in the Gulf of Mexico, where he reveals the cutting-edge engineering behind this high-tech facility and its record-breaking drills.
Rob Nelson heads to Lake Michigan to investigate an unexplained, Bermuda Triangle-like phenomenon that has caused ships to disappear for centuries.
A legendary train filled with stolen Nazi gold is said to be hidden in Poland. Rob and Stefan explore deep under the earth's surface to uncover the truth.
Half of the star systems in our galaxy have not one, but two stars, possibly creating ideal habitats for alien life. Here, binary stars fling entire worlds into space.
New research shows the migration of ice planets may have helped start life on Earth, and stopped it being destroyed. How are they so vital?
Quasars are the brightest objects in space, powered by black holes, and the most mysterious. How do they shape the universe and ultimately aid in its destruction?
How do they build bamboo bicycles, create chainsaw art and make breath mints? Find out as more everyday items are put under the microscope.
As more everyday items are put under the microscope, finding out how dinner sets, air brake tanks and frosted cereal are made.
How do they make clay, pitted prunes, spurs and polyurethane tyres? Find out, as more everyday items are put under the microscope.
How do they make tasers, canned soup, diving boards, jaw harps and mouth bows? Find out as more everyday items are put under the microscope.
How do they make Navajo rugs, crude oil, kaleidoscopes and titanium dental implants? Find out as everyday items are put under the microscope.
How do they make space pens, reef aquariums and metal caskets? Find out as more everyday items are put under the microscope.
Black holes are not the violent monsters people think they are, and new discoveries reveal that they might have been essential to creating stars, giving light and building the universe itself.
Nebulas are the strange structures of cosmic gas and dust where stars are born and die. New discoveries reveal the secrets of these mysterious places.
Experts investigate whether the Roswell UFO incident was a Soviet conspiracy masterminded by Stalin, or just another cover-up.
In the late 1800s two great minds, Thomas Edison and Nikola Tesla, built systems that would dramatically change life by bringing light and power to the world.
Mike and Elvis take on the 'baby Ferrari' but want to keep their costs low. The guys must try their best to restore this old school classic car and make it a rival to its Italian cousin once again.

Locals face off in Ohio, and one racer manages to negotiate their races, getting further than anyone expected. Then, the $5,000 prize winner goes up against the infamous Kye Kelley -- but Kye is worried about how the race will go down.
Pennsylvania locals race for $5000. With Caden Rankin, the son of an NPK racer, in the field, all bets are off. The winner faces Axman, known for never backing down.
Competition reality, Documentary, Auto racing, Reality
Michiganders compete for $5,000, and a racing wagon surprises everyone. Then, the last local standing goes up against Bobby Ducote for another $5,000.
How do they produce tequila from cactus plants in Mexico, how does New York City run on steam, and how do they make soft ice cream?
How do stuntmen survive a bad day at work, how do they mine precious amber gemstones, and how do they build Seabreacher watercraft that move like dolphins?

Derek teams up with his brother Sean to convert a 1966 Oldsmobile F-85 from a wannabe drag racer into a timeless cruiser. It'll take more than a paint job to make this car street-able, as the guys discover the engine is keeping a horrible secret.
An excited Drew and Paul get their hands on what has become known as "the poor man's Porsche", and set out to change the 914's reputation once and for all.
Ant takes a gamble on a mysterious Mark1 Capri, and Ant's girlfriend, Renée Zellweger, surprises him with a cool addition for the home.

Bike guru Henry Cole and ace-mechanic Sam Lovegrove are in Cornwall, looking for something to buy, restore and sell on for a handsome profit. At a windswept hilltop farm they find cars, tractors and a very rare German scooter.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in the New Forest, looking for things to buy, restore and sell for profit. Today they meet Stumpie, an Americana fanatic whose sheds are full of rare bicycles, classic sportsters and pimped up saloon cars.

Richard Hammond climbs aboard the US Air Force's biggest cargo plane, an airborne behemoth that uses cutting-edge engineering, and the latest technology to fly vital equipment and heavy-duty military vehicles across the planet.

When Andy Cohen decides to transplant a Dodge Hell Cat engine into his classic Plymouth Barracuda, it is all hands on deck, but even his best guys cannot promise it will work. Bobby tries to salvage two beat-up ATVs without losing any money.

A deadly design flaw results in a horrifying rush hour bridge collapse that tragically leaves 13 dead in Minneapolis. Using the latest science, experts investigate to reveal what went wrong on one of Minnesota's busiest crossings.

An unprecedented cycle of freezing and thawing causes dramatic destruction to a landmark bridge in Pennsylvania; experts investigate and reveal how a sudden surge of icy flood water buckled pier foundations weakened from years of erosion.
The day finally arrives when Chris and Francis attempt to start 025's engine, but after two years of silence there's no guarantee it'll work.
With Mike planning to turn a second-generation Chevrolet Camaro into a proper pro touring car, Edd begins installing a pro touring stage three kit but must also replace the current engine.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in Cornwall, looking for things to buy, restore and sell on for a profit. Today they visit the Queen's armourer, Terry English, and find an amazing collection of vintage British cars, bikes and engines.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in the West Country searching for things to buy, restore and sell for a profit. Today they discover sheds full of classic bikes, vintage cars and extraordinary limousines, including one owned by Eva Perón.
Chris, Francis and the team race to assemble their beloved 37025 before her main line test. Any failure will scupper their Highland dreams.
Jason Cammisa and Jonny Lieberman are at the snow-covered Bridgestone Winter Driving School to test two high-performance SUVs. The Porsche Macan GTS will do battle with the Jaguar F-Pace.
The world's quickest sedans battle it out as Jason Cammisa and Jonny Lieberman test drive the Audi RS7 and Tesla Model S.

A devastating railroad inferno takes down a vital route on a historic river crossing in Arizona; using the latest cutting-edge technology, experts investigate the remaining incinerated evidence to determine what caused such a disastrous derailment.
John, Steve, Deano and Simon move four huge 90-ton dumper trucks from South Wales to Tilbury docks. Plus, Arran takes modular homes from the Hull manufacturers to a Bedford school.
Mike tracks down a rare '91 Alfa Romeo 164L. He loves the look, but Ant has his work cut out for him. The car has perfect bodywork, but it has a leaking engine.
Investoren haben sich angekündigt, um die Show auf ihre europäischen Marktchancen zu testen. Dafür hat sich Tim schon etwas ganz Besonderes einfallen lassen.

Neueste Produkte werden im Fernsehen für ein bequemes Einkaufserlebnis präsentiert. Von praktischen Haushaltshelfern und weichen Badetüchern bis hin zu vielseitigen Sportgeräten bietet das abwechslungsreiche Sortiment zahlreiche Angebote.

Die Sendung bringt mit vielen neuen Ideen frischen Wind auf die Bildschirme. Schneiden, Kleben, Ausmalen und Mitgestalten - sie zeigt großen und kleinen Zuschauern, wie man aus den unscheinbarsten Dingen die tollsten Sachen zaubert.

Als Gregorias Bruder zu Besuch ist, befürchtet sie, dass die Hauntleys ihren Bruder viel mehr mögen werden als sie. Die ganze Familie macht sich Sorgen um Bigfoot, der trotz Ankündigung nicht in der Pension erschienen ist.

Da sowohl die Küche als auch die anderen Räume im Wunderhaus belegt sind, findet Minnie keinen Rückzugsort. Deshalb plant Micky eine Überraschung: Mithilfe einer Erfindung von Professor von Quack schenkt er Minnie ein eigenes, pinkes Wunderhaus.

Bingo liegt im Krankenhaus, also schicken Bluey und Dad ihr ein selbstgedrehtes Video, um sie aufzuheitern. Es erzählt von Barnicus' Mission, ihren Hund namens Bumpy, der eines Morgens mit bunten Punkten aufwacht, zu heilen.

Papa muss sich auf den Weg zur Arbeit machen. Jedoch wollen Bluey und Bingo ihn nicht gehen lassen. Sie versuchen ihn so lang wie möglich festzuhalten. Dazu denken die beiden sich ein Trampolinspiel nach dem anderen aus.

Bei einem Ausflug zur Müllhalde behauptet Papa, dass er in allem der Beste ist. Doch als Bluey entdeckt, dass er eine ihrer alten Zeichnungen wegwerfen will, bekommt sie Zweifel, ob er wirklich der beste Papa der Welt ist.

Bluey hat einen eigenen Hinterhof-Zoo, in dem viele wundervolle Tiere leben. Besonders beliebt ist der große blaue Papa Gorilla. Doch der schnappt sich die Besucherin Bingo. Daraufhin muss die Zoowärterin Bluey das wilde Tier wieder einfangen.
Das Spidey-Team sucht nach Peters Katze Bootsie, die von Black Cat entführt wurde.

Sofia nimmt an einem magischen Wettkampf gegen Schüler aus den anderen Schlössern teil. Layla versucht derweil einen Schwebezauber. Sie offenbart dabei jedoch stattdessen ihre Fähigkeit, Schmetterlingsflügel wachsen zu lassen.
Loomis und Fifi wollen beide mit Cloudimus spielen. Die Magicampers machen eine Schatzsuche.

Als Claires Bauanfrage für den Hinterhof abgelehnt wird, kennen nur Phil und Luke den wahren Grund. Derweil verrät Pameron Cam ein Familiengeheimnis. Dieser ist dermaßen schockiert, dass er sich Hilfe von einem Therapeuten holt.

Als Phil starke Bauchschmerzen hat, bringt Gloria ihn für eine Notoperation ins Krankenhaus und versammelt die ganze Familie an seiner Seite. Unterdessen ist Cam wütend auf Mitchell, da sich dieser für einen anderen Mann interessiert.
Abby ist eine absolute Tierliebhaberin, doch dann findet sie heraus, dass Greg und Edward gern angeln. Weil sie gern einen Angelausflug machen wollen, wirft Greg sie aus Haus Finkelstein raus.
In dieser Folge werden Rückblicke in das Leben von Greg und Dharma, bevor ihrer Hochzeit und den davor gelegenen Dates, gezeigt.

Dharma und Kitty gehen zum Spatenstich für ein Freilufttheater. Doch Dharma ist schockiert, als sie erfährt, dass das Theater mitten in einem Naturschutzgebiet errichtet werden soll. Sie will den Bau verhindern und startet sofort eine Protestaktion.

Jess versucht, sich mit Coach besser anzufreunden, und gibt vor, dasselbe Basketballteam wie er zu mögen. Nick allerdings verteidigt vehement sein Lieblingsteam und tritt deshalb in einen Sexstreik. Derweil tut sich für Winston eine neue Karriererichtung auf und Schmidt muss auf der Arbeit einen neuen Kollegen einarbeiten, der allerdings viel älter ist als er.

Nick will für Jess die perfekte Geburtstagsfeier organisieren. Doch leider ist sie etwas enttäuscht über das Programm, das Nick zusammengestellt hat. Schmidt schiebt inzwischen Überstunden, um Cece bei ihrem neuen Job als Barkeeperin zu helfen.

Es ist Geisterstunde und Bentleys Vorfahr Hentley tritt nach langer Zeit wieder in Erscheinung. Natürlich ist er sehr verärgert, dass sich immer noch diese falsche Katze in der Villa herumtreibt. Daher bietet er seine Hilfe an.

Taffy rettet Mr. Corgi versehentlich vor einem fatalen Steinschlag. Corgi steht nun tief in Taffys Schuld und betrachtet es als eine Frage der Ehre, seinen Lebensretter fortan mit allen Mitteln vor jeglichem Unheil zu bewahren.
Beni steht diesmal vor der großen Herausforderung, ein Selfie mit Blitzlicht zu schießen.

Die Schüler Marinette und Adrien erhalten die Fähigkeit, sich in die Superhelden Ladybug und Cat Noir zu verwandeln und können dadurch das Glück und das Pech manipulieren. Sie wollen dem Bösewicht Hawk Moth das Handwerk legen.

Um Alix eine Geburtstagsfeier im Kreise ihrer Liebsten zu ermöglichen, greift Marinette zu besonderen Mitteln. Sie holt den Hasen Miraculous zurück und schlüpft für einige Stunden in die verantwortungsvolle Rolle der Hüterin der Zeit.
Durch einen Computerfehler wird Barry in die Highschool versetzt und Liff gezwungen, ihm zu folgen.

Cricket und seine Familie ziehen vom Land in die Großstadt, was zuerst einen großen Kulturschock auslöst. Doch Cricket ist optimistisch und naiv, was ihn schnell neue Freunde finden lässt. Zusammen erleben sie viele Abenteuer in der großen Stadt.
Nachdem er wegen seines Händedrucks verspottet wurde, trainiert Cricket für ein Händedruckduell.
Clevers Käfignachbarn in der Tierhandlung wurden über Nacht entführt. Er muss sie finden.

Das neueste Experiment, Insekto, sieht wie ein Käfer aus. Lilo befasst sich zurzeit sehr mit Insekten und hat sogar eine Kolonie in ihrem Zimmer gegründet, was Nani nicht besonders gefällt. Als das neue Experiment aktiviert wird, verwandelt es alle Wesen in harmlose Insekten. Bis Jumba endlich dahinter kommt, sind Lilo, Stitch, Jumba und Pleakley schon zu kleinen Insekten geworden. Nani heuert einen Kammerjäger an, um die vielen Insekten im Haus loszuwerden.

Phineas, Ferb und ihre Freunde versuchen, einen gordischen Knoten zu knoten und zu entknoten. Währenddessen versucht Candace herauszufinden, was sich in Jeremys Mini Safe befindet. Die Phineas-Truppe stimmt einer Gedankentauschreise mit Aliens zu, jedoch bringt sie das in mächtige Schwierigkeiten. Währenddessen hat Doofenshmirtz eine Square-Dancing-Verabredung.

Dad hat sich einfach auf ein Ende der Wippe gesetzt. Deswegen treiben Bluey und Bingo den gesamten Spielplatz zusammen, um zu helfen, Dad aus dem Weg zu räumen. Doch damit es klappt, müssen sie noch einen weiteren Freund finden.
Opa soll sich ausruhen, doch Bluey und Bingo besuchen ihn und sie begeben sich auf ein Abenteuer.

Als Muffins Vater ihr sagt, dass sie etwas Besonderes sei, benutzt sie dies als Ausrede, um zu tun, was sie will. Muffins Meinung nach kann sie nun zum Beispiel Blueys und Bingos Bibliotheksspiel auf jede Art spielen, die ihr gefällt.

Mama, Papa und Bingo müssen beide Klassen abschließen, um die Schwimmschule zu bestehen. Doch es erweist sich als gar nicht so einfach, die strenge Big Fish-Lehrerin Margaret, alias Bluey, mit guten Leistungen zufriedenzustellen.
Bluey, Bingo und Papa bringen immer die Mülltonnen raus. Im Laufe einiger Wochen erzählt Bingo Papa von einem neuen Kind im Kindergarten, das gemein zu ihr ist, und Mama gibt ihm einen guten Rat.
Adrien forscht über seinen Vater. Marinette versucht, ihre geheimen Informationen zu hüten.

Die Schüler Marinette und Adrien erhalten die Fähigkeit, sich in die Superhelden Ladybug und Cat Noir zu verwandeln und können dadurch das Glück und das Pech manipulieren. Sie wollen dem Bösewicht Hawk Moth das Handwerk legen.

Cricket lässt Gloria mit der Arbeit im Café alleine, denn er will die Fünfzehn-Minuten-Pause dafür nutzen, die Parade zu sehen. Bill nutzt einen Ausflug zum Baumarkt, um Remy eine Lektion in Eigenständigkeit zu erteilen.

Als Luke nach einer Feier in einer dubiosen Nachbarschaft verschwindet, suchen Manny, Phil und Gloria ihn gemeinsam. Unterdessen versucht Haley, ein Interview mit dem Gründer einer beliebten Lifestyle-Website auszumachen.

Am Valentinstag rät Phil Jay zu einem Rollenspiel mit der aufgebrachten Gloria, damit diese sich wieder beruhigt. Derweil ruinieren Cam und Mitch unwillentlich Lukes Verabredung. Unterdessen schwärmt Joe plötzlich für Claire.

Tim bittet Harrys Sohn Dennis darum, einen zweiten Telefonanschluss in seinem Haus einzurichten. Während des Einbaus wird Dennis allerdings zu einem anderen Auftrag gerufen und so muss Tim die Arbeit zu Ende bringen.

Brad hat seine Führerscheinprüfung erfolgreich abgeschlossen und will sich Tims Wagen ausleihen. Jill, die darüber besorgt ist, wird auch gleich in ihren Zweifeln bestätigt, als Brad einen Unfall baut.
Tim steht vor einem neuen Rekord: Er hat bald mehr Heimwerkersendungen präsentiert als Bob Vila. Doch sein bevorstehender Triumph wird durch eine Schulterverletzung gefährdet.

Der jährliche Familienausflug zur Haushaltswarenausstellung in Cleveland steht bevor. Jill freut sich, mit den Kindern etwas unternehmen zu können und Tim moderiert von dort aus seine Sendung. Die Kinder haben jedoch dort andere Pläne.

Jill kann nicht glauben, dass Brad's Freundin Angela so ein Hausmütterchen ist. Angela macht alles für Brad, der sich gerne umsorgen lässt. Jill beschließt, mit Angela zu reden und dem ein Ende zu bereiten.

Bevor Robin um zwei Uhr morgens zu ihrem Job als Moderatorin aufbricht, legt sie einen Zwischenstopp im MacLaren's ein. Dort amüsieren sich ihre Freunde gerade über Marshall, dem am Morgen zuvor ein peinliches Missgeschick passiert ist: Nach Beendigung seines allmorgendlichen Fitnessprogramms in der Firma musste er feststellen, dass er seine Anzughose zu Hause vergessen hatte. Notgedrungen sah Marshall sich gezwungen, in Boxershorts zur Arbeit zu kommen.

Lily und Marshall können Teds Freundin Karen nicht leiden. Deshalb legt Lily ein Ohrring von Robin in Teds Bett. Als Karen diesen findet, ist sie empört und trennt sich sofort. Als Lilys Trick auffliegt, muss Ted eine schwierige Entscheidung treffen.
Marshall und Barney wollen die Nachrichten von Goliath National Bank vor Ted verheimlichen. Der Kunde hat Teds Pläne für das neue Gebäude nicht angenommen.
Ted hat sich vorgenommen, nach seinem 30. Geburtstag keine kindlichen Sachen mehr zu machen. Er hat eine Liste dieser Sachen zusammengestellt: die Murtaugh-Liste.

Ted gründet ein eigenes kleines Architekturbüro namens "Mosbius Designs" - mit Sitz in seinem und Robins Apartment. Im Zuge der Firmengründung stellt er den ehrgeizigen jungen PJ als seinen Assistenten ein.

Phil und Heather sind auf der Spur eines Vampirs, Chupacabra. Er treibt sein Unwesen in Texas. Die Legende begann 1995 auf Puerto Rico. Die Inselbewohner waren zutiefst beunruhigt wegen zahlreicher Angriffe auf ihre Nutztiere.

In Massachusetts gibt es einen Hotspot für rätselhafte Phänomene. Die Menschen berichten von Geistern, Bigfoots und UFOs. In einem Dreieck zwischen den Städten Abington, Freetown und Rehoboth werden seit vielen Jahren seltsame Vorgänge gemeldet.

Im Jahr 1971 zog die Familie Perron in Harrisville in das historische Arnold Farmhouse. Roger, Carolyn und ihre fünf Töchter freuten sich auf ein ruhiges Leben. Doch bereits nach einer Woche machten die Perrons schreckliche Erfahrungen.

Im 17. Jahrhundert internierten britische Streitkräfte auf Spike Island Tausende von Gefangenen. Das Eiland war berüchtigt. Die Häftlinge mussten schwere Arbeit verrichten, erhielten jedoch kaum Nahrung. Wer nicht mithalten konnte, wurde mit Brutalität und Isolation bestraft. In den überfüllten Zellen breiteten sich Tuberkulose und Cholera aus, unzählige Menschen starben. Und schlimmes Leid hinterlässt immer Spuren? Besucher und Mitarbeiter berichten auf der Insel von paranormalen Vorfällen.

Christina Scheib startet mit 20 Tonnen Dosenbier auf dem Hänger in Richtung Schweiz, doch bevor es über die Grenze geht, ereilt Christina ein herber Verlust. Markus Rüesegger schneidet unterdessen in Tennessee das Profil seiner Reifen nach.

Der 4. Juli ist in den USA ein wichtiger Feiertag und Markus Rüesegger freut sich besonders auf das Feuerwerk. Doch vorher geht es mit einer Ladung Papierrollen nach Lewisburg. Gergios Keprios bleibt unterdessen im Ruhrpott keine Zeit zum Feiern.

Auf dem Flughafen in Barcelona irrt eine unbekannte Person auf dem Gelände herum. Zwei Polizeiteams rücken aus, um die Gefahr zu bannen. Im Hafen von Algeciras hält die Polizei Ausschau nach illegalen Einwanderern und Drogenhandel.

Thorsten Eckert springt für einen Kollegen ein, der aufgrund eines Geschwindigkeitsvergehens für drei Monate seinen Führerschein abgeben muss. Thorsten muss gerodete Baumstämme aus einem polnischen Land ins Sägewerk transportieren.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Max Cornelius hat auf einer Gurkentour eine Ape ergattert. Das Rollermobil des Herstellers Piaggio wird seit 1948 hergestellt und kam ein Jahr nach der Vespa. Der Klassiker eignet sich dank seiner Kompaktheit perfekt für den Warentransport.

Die Vorbereitungen für die neue Campingsaison laufen auf Hochtouren. Doch gleich zu Beginn muss der Familien-Clan in Brandenburg eine bittere Hiobsbotschaft verkraften. Ein Wasserrohrbruch wirbelt die Pläne des Teams durcheinander.

In sieben Tagen werden die ersten Erholungssuchenden an der Himmelspforte erwartet. Bis dahin muss alles vorbereitet sein. William will mit tatkräftiger Unterstützung von Dauercamper Robert am Schwielowsee das Event-Boot zu Wasser lassen.

Ein Wildhüter begegnet einem Steinsammler und kommt einem verheerenden Geheimnis auf die Spur. Ein Teenager wird mit der Kamera dabei erwischt, wie er geschützte Vogelnester zerstört, und eine Menschenmenge bedroht die Sicherheit am Sam Rayburn See.

Als ein Austernkapitän Konfrontation sucht, entdeckt der Beamte, dass eines der Besatzungsmitglieder schon mal Kontakt mit dem Gesetz hatte. Ein anderer Aufseher findet verdächtige Eindringlinge und die Tochter eines Kollegen hat Schulabschluss.

Bei Dauerbelastung im Eiswasser der Beringsee machen selbst aufwändig gewartete Schiffe schlapp. Diese Erkenntnis wird gleich zwei Captains ins Gedächtnis gerufen. Zum einen hat Jake Anderson mit einem gerissenen Hydraulikschlauch zu kämpfen, der das gesamte Deck der Saga mit einer Schmierschicht aus Öl überzieht. Zum anderen machen seltsame Geräusche im Schiffsrumpf Skipper Keith Colburn hellhörig. Nach intensiver Fehlersuche steht fest: Ein Wassereinbruch ist dafür verantwortlich.

Ein massives Tiefdruckgebiet bahnt sich seinen Weg durch die Beringsee. Windböen mit Orkanstärke und bis zu achteinhalb Meter hohe Brecher sind vom Küstenwetterdienst vorhergesagt. Bei dem aufziehenden Sturm handelt es sich um einen Hurrikan.

Die Krabbenfischer im Nordpazifik mobilisieren ihre letzten Kraftreserven, um die Saison für Königskrabben erfolgreich zu Ende zu bringen. Während Co-Kapitän Josh Harris seine Männer mit einem Wetteinsatz bei Laune hält, geht an Bord der Saga ein Fischer mit Fußverletzung zu Boden. Wild Bill Wichrowski hat seine Quote bereits erreicht. Insgesamt sind fast 30.000 Kilogramm Krustentiere im Bauch der Summer Bay verschwunden. Auch die Bezahlung der Crew kann sich sehen lassen.

Die Steel Buddys wollen aus einem Militär-Lkw Profit schlagen. Der Foden soll nach einer schnellen Wartung auf dem Firmengelände direkt zum neuen Besitzer weiterwandern. Aber das Vehikel macht bereits auf der Fahrt nach Peterslahr Probleme.

A couple plans to build an oceanfront oasis for their family in Maui, Hawaii and, to keep the budget low, they design a Quonset hut which can be built cheaply and quickly, but unexpected setbacks test their limits at every turn.

A young couple sets out to create their dream treehouse retreat in Northern Georgia overlooking the breathtaking Blue Ridge Mountains. Although the build calls for a mile-long, uphill trek, they hope it will go smoothly.
Edgar must make a dangerous repair, while questionable counting makes Sig lose his temper. On Cornelia Marie, Phil's health is failing and it's affecting the crew.

Josh Gates travels to Turkey and Hungary to find the heart of Suleiman the Magnificent. Archaeologists are eager to reunite the heart with the Sultan's body as the 450th anniversary of his death nears.

Josh travels to South Africa in search of former President Kruger's missing gold cache. Josh evades dangerous poachers and meets the Shangaan tribe en route to the treasure that may be hiding in the African wilderness.

A widowed homesteader, realising she didn't learn the skills she needed before her husband's passing, is overwhelmed by her large family homestead; her six kids are now even more determined to protect their dad's off-grid legacy and over 100 animals.

Chris suffers a spider bite. Slim Pickings' Lee battles dangerous ground on a quad bike. And a big mechanical failure halts Dan and Renee's enterprise.
The Victoria Diggers' desperately fight for survival, but they may have stumbled across a monster nugget. The Gold Gypsies fend off deadly snakes during their search.
The Gold Gypsies hunt for nuggets in ancient mine shafts and Greg discovers a rare meteorite. The Mahoneys chase for more gold using Ted's granddad's treasure map.
A farmer is bitten by a cobra hidden under his pillow and a teenager on a rafting trip is mauled by a black bear.
A young boy stung by hundreds of ants and game ranger viciously attacked by a lioness fight for their lives. Follow their extraordinary tales of survival.
Phil and Jess search whitewater rapids and a frigid Alaskan lake for a legendary beast that's now the target of serious scientific enquiry.

Hikers are going missing amid reports of grotesque, human-like creatures prowling Appalachia's Great Smoky Mountains; Phil and Jess venture into the unforgiving wilderness to investigate the truth behind terrifying sightings of feral people.

Eine Ehefrau im Pech: sie hat bereits sechs reiche Ehemänner verloren. Oder ist es gar keine Pechsträhne? Gut möglich, dass sie nachgeholfen hat, was einen Versicherungsermittler und einen Detektiv auf den Plan ruft.

Entdecken Sie die schockierende Wahrheit über das geheime Leben der Schüler! In diesem explosiven Film geraten unschuldige Teenager in ein Netz aus Intrigen und verbotenen Abenteuern. Ihre Welt wird auf den Kopf gestellt, als dunkle Geheimnisse.

Fridolin hat große Beziehungsprobleme. Er hat den dringenden Verdacht, dass seine Frau ihn mit einem anderen Mann betrügt. Nur so kann er sich erklären, dass er schon seit längerer Zeit keinen Sex mehr hat.

Tom und Ben begleiten einen Wagentreck in die neue Heimat. Auf dem gefährlichen Weg müssen die Siedler zahlreiche Abenteuer bestehen, Gefahren meistern und lernen, zusammenzuhalten, während sich ihre Reise zu einer schwierigen Prüfung entwickelt.

Michael Niekammer trifft die Schlagersängerin Daniela Alfinito bei einem Videodreh in Slowenien. Im persönlichen Gespräch gewährt die Künstlerin private Einblicke, spricht über die große Liebe und ihr neues Album und präsentiert bekannte Hits.

Abenteurer Ben plant, mit Wunderkäfer Dudu an der Ostafrika-Rallye teilzunehmen. Mit der Siegprämie will er das Urwaldhospital von Ärztin Daktari Jo retten. Zuerst gilt es aber, fiese Konkurrenten zu schlagen - vor allem den gerissenen Schotten James Butler. Mit seinem umgebauten Luftkissenboot "Queen" kann dieser nämlich abseits befestigter Straßen fahren und geht somit schnell in Führung. Aber auch das Superauto Dudu hat einige Tricks auf Lager.

Charlie Rogers arbeitet als Sänger in einem Café. Nach einer Schlägerei mit Gästen schmeißt ihn sein Boss endgültig raus. Kurz darauf hat der Sänger mit seinem Motorrad einen Unfall. Dabei lernt er Maggie kennen. Die Jahrmarktbetreiberin bietet Charlie einen Job auf ihrem Rummelplatz an. Dieser steckt allerdings tief in der Krise. Doch Charlie lässt sich etwas einfallen, um den Rummelplatz vor dem Ruin zu retten.

Fleischermeister Frantiek Schwejk macht sich Sorgen um seinen Sohn Josef. Der Bursche zeigt weder fürs Geschäft noch fürs Militär Interesse. Als der Einberufungsbescheid kommt, muss Schwejk Junior in die Kaserne. Doch statt zu exerzieren, verbringt der neue Rekrut seine Tage vergnüglich im Arrest beim Kartenspiel, bis Oberleutnant Gustl ihn zu seinem Dienstburschen macht. Der brave Soldat Schwejk gibt sich daraufhin die größte Mühe, Ordnung in das verwirrende Liebesleben seines Herrn zu bringen.

Das Mädchen Verena ist in einfachen Verhältnissen aufgewachsen und wurde durch die Heirat mit Anatol Manesse-Manconi zur Gräfin. Doch der Graf ist herzlos und unfähig zur Liebe. Er macht Verena zu seinem Lustobjekt, auch vor seinen Gästen. Eine Reihe von seltsamen Männern, die die sieben Todsünden verkörpern, gaffen auf Verena, die als Göttin der Triebe präsentiert wird. Dann wird der Mechaniker Toni ermordet.
