Everyone prepares for Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow's wedding; Peppa and the soon-to-be-weds go to the jewellers to get rings, to the dressmakers, to get a wedding dress and finally to Peppa's house to sort the wedding cake.
The day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull wedding arrives, but not everything goes to plan; nothing stops it being the best wedding ever and there is a lot of happy crying.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Holly takes some frogspawn home from class to look after but is surprised when the frogspawn turns into tadpoles overnight. Soon there are lots of little frogs for Holly to look after.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.
Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task of making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks. The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter.

It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.
Thomas and Diesel must take a batch of delicious treats to the Sodor Cake Festival, but their cargo doesn't travel well.
Paddington builds a robot that he calls Paddington that requires a real friend to work, Baaz invites everyone to celebrate Diwali with him, and Paddington is his helpful assistant.

Paddington has a race against time in order to enjoy his first ever solar eclipse. Paddington accepts an inventor's award for Simi when she's too shy to step up, but it makes Simi feel jealous and sad.

The Browns meet Shantee the lighthouse keeper when they arrive at the beach for their holiday. Paddington, Jonathan, and Judy become trainee lifeguards and end up rescuing Mr Brown with Taylor the lifeguard's help.

Something is making the strange noises in the cave. Jonathan thinks it's a mermaid, but Paddington isn't so sure. Judy wants to find a fossil on the beach, but everyone else seems to be getting lucky except her. Paddington tries to help.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.
Chickaletta is stuck on a runaway drone and butterflies cause chaos all around Adventure Bay.
The statue of Chickaletta has been stolen by Mayor Humdinger and is making its way through Adventure Bay's underground tunnel system.

It's World Book Day, and Paddington helps Mateo discover his favourite character. Paddington, Simi, and Jonathan are on a dinosaur hunt on the island in the park, but they are unsure if dinosaurs still exist.

When things go missing in Windsor Gardens, Jonathan believes a black hole is to blame, so Paddington goes on a space mission. Simi and Paddington try to find the gold at the end of the rainbow after they break Baaz's kaleidoscope.
Paddington has to decide whether to support England or Peru before the football match, but he loves both countries. It's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still time for one last adventure.
When Captain Squid leaves his treasure map in the Little Kingdom, Redbeard the Elf Pirate leads Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum on a treasure hunt.
After the disappearance of Mrs Fotheringill, Mrs Elf becomes the twins' new teacher.
Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when they say please and thank you.

It's time for playgroup, and Peppa and friends are thinking about what they want to be when they grow up. Some in the group want to be nurses, police officers and even pirates, but Peppa takes a little while to figure out what she wants to be.

Grandpa and Granny Pig show and share with Peppa and George their toys and hobbies. Granny shows her special doll from childhood and Grandpa his love of building toy planes. Peppa and George have great fun when Grandpa reveals his new biggest plane ever that even George can fit in.

Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. They see Grampy Rabbit and his pet newt. Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit about how she wishes she could exercise more but doesn't have any room. Grampy Rabbit decides to build something special to help Dr Hamster exercise more.
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play, and build whatever the community needs.
PAW Patrol is a CG action-adventure preschool series starring a pack of six heroic puppies led by a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy named Ryder.
When Crusher's super-powered vacuum goes haywire and sucks up everything in its path, Pickle must team up with Blaze and AJ to stop the vacuum and save Crusher.
When Gabby and Pandy find a magical jar of googly eyes, they're in for a trouble-making surprise; luckily, MerCat knows just how to burst trouble's bubble.
Gaston catches a cold when his cave has a leaky roof, so Holly invites him to stay at the Little Castle until it is fixed, but soon Gaston is taking over.
When a spell accidentally goes wrong, Ben and Holly grow to human size! Now they are able to play with Lucy and her friends and want to stay big forever.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.

Rebecca and Richard Rabbit are playing a marble run game at Peppa's house. But when Daddy Pig joins in and improvises tunnels and bridges, the marble rolls out of the bedroom, causing chaos and nearly knocking Goldie out of her bowl.
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
Peppa and her friends from playgroup visit a science museum, where they learn all sorts of things.

Dwayne is a huge fan of Lily's waffles, but she refuses to make any more for him. So he decides to get his revenge. Diaper Daddy feels neglected among the Smurfs and decides to go in search of a place where he will be loved.

Julius loses his tooth and has a dream that the PAW Patrol saves a bumbling Tooth Fairy; when all the paintings mysteriously disappear from the Art Museum festival, the PAW Patrol must solve the missing art mystery and return all the paintings.
Cali gets lost in the woods. Meanwhile, Daring Danny X's harness becomes loose while kite-surfing. He must fix it before he gets hurt.
Rosa kicks Stan out of the park. It's the Earth Day Games at school.
It is harvest day. The elves and fairies enlist the help of Mr Gnome in picking blackberries. If only they could stop him from eating them all.
Nanny Plum and The Wise Old Elf each think they work harder than the other. King Thistle commands them to swap for the day to find out.
King Thistle has a cold and needs some medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly, and Ben, have a lot of fun collecting the ingredients to make a magic potion to cure his cold and make him better.
Tim, Tommy, and Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner.
Tim fakes it to prove he's just as cool as Kai's cousin.
Tim and Kai try to uncover trinkets buried at the beach.
When a penguin takes a shine to Stink's bed, and Grumblestunk decides to open a zoo, Brody is unimpressed, so Stan and Gran are forced to investigate!
Stan and his friends are at the Ley to do a nature survey but strangely, there doesn't seem to be anything to spot. Where has all the wildlife gone?
A young witch is afraid of failing. Clarion seeks help finding a Familiar.
Peppa and Suzy are excited about the sleepover and sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they grow up.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the charity shop to sell things they don't need, and things they may need.
After messing up his hug attack and getting a hole in his pack, Pandy realises he's having a bad day, and things just keep getting worse.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
On a beautiful sunny day, Grandpa takes Peppa and George to spend the day sailing. After an accident, the boat ends up sinking, and now they need rescuing with a hovercraft.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.

It's the Twin's birthday party and chaos ensues when their little friends arrive. The Wise Old Elf tries to entertain them, but they prove too much of a handful, turning the Wise Old Elf into a mouse and ending up in the secret room.
Snooty King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit, but when the King's new clothes get dirty Nanny cleans them, along with the King's old clothes and shrinks them all.
When a precious marble statue of his great-grandfather arrives, Sir Topham Hatt enlists the help of Thomas and Bruno in delivering it to Vicarstown Plaza.
After Salty the Diesel Engine returns from his worldly travels, he sings a shanty to Thomas and Percy about a legendary treasure lost on the island of Sodor.
Tim tries to bend all the rules when Terri comes to babysit.
Tim sets out to prove Kai's Dad is Captain DinoStar.
Tim, Tommy, Tia and Grandma go on the search for treasure.
Paddington and Robot Paddington enjoy being heroes, Paddington discovers how to be calm.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
King Thistle is bored in the Royal Castle and takes up the hobby of birdwatching. Using his magic bird book, the King is pleased when another creature makes a nest in the Royal Castle.
Rainbows are a pirate's best friend if they're looking for a pot of gold. Captain Squid is hiding treasure though, so Rainbows are this pirate's worst enemy.
Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse, which has a fold-down counter at the front. The children pretend to run a little shop for the parents to buy things from.

Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. They learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods. They all end up having toast with fun toppings. Finally, they have a good stretch and dance to get ready for the day and all sing the breakfast song.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
When Daddy Pig is given a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children - and that they get told off too.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?
Peppa and George are re-enacting the Apollo Moon Landing with the help of Granny Pig's friends. Grampy Rabbit lends them his rocket, but no one has told him it's just pretend.
When George loses the metal wind-up key for his toy robot in the long grass, Grandpa Pig cannot find his metal detector to help George track it down.
Peppa and her friends have fun while painting in the playgroup. Madame Gazelle then teaches them how to play games with parachutes.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Peppa and George check out Grandpa's new Bug Hotel as lots of insects arrive. A bumblebee cannot find a place in the hotel because the rooms are too small for him.

Madame Gazelle presents the poetry to Peppa and her friends, explaining that sounds can also be poems. When it starts raining, the inspired children create a beautiful poem about the rain and recite it to their parents.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown around by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.
Dr Hamster's pet tortoise, Tiddles, once again gets stuck on top of a tree, but everyone in the rescue team finds it tough to get the tortoise down.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic, but they have trouble deciding what to throw out because Granny and Grandpa want to keep everything.

It's a beautiful day but Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig are sitting inside watching the motor racing on the television. Granny Pig shoos them all outside to enjoy the sunshine. Inspired by the racing, Grandpa Pig builds George his own racing car.
Peppa and George go to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig and realise not all beaches are sandy. This one has lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore.
The doctor teaches children what to do if there is ever an accident. A patient soon appears, and they put into practise the new techniques they have learned.
There's a spider in the house. Mummy Pig tells Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes.
Peppa's playgroup are really enjoying Grampy Rabbit's talk about space rockets, until suddenly he loses his voice. Doctor Brown Bear must get him speaking again.

Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson, and meets her friends Candy, Suzy, Rebecca, Danny and Pedro there. She decides to teach Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig to dance but finds out they have some moves of their own.
George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.
The family have a special day planned for George's birthday. They visit the museum and see dinosaurs, before ending the day with cake.
Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper until everyone helps him train to win it back.
Madame Gazelle introduces a new pupil to the playgroup, Emily Elephant, and everyone wants to be her friend because she's very good at building blocks and can make a very loud noise with her trunk.
Peppa, George and Daddy are in the garden painting a picture of a cherry tree when the ducks turn up and run through the paint, and all over their masterpiece.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Peppa and George join Grandma Piggy and her friends to play a game pretending to be Vikings. The Vikings enjoy Grandpa Piggy's boat until they realise they forgot about the picnic.
PC Panda brings his twin daughters to playgroup Peggy and Pandora Panda. They love puzzles and to solve mysteries just like their dad.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa builds a special hiding hut to watch birds in so they can all go owl-spotting.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy, but Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
Peppa and all her friends at playgroup dress up as different countries from all over the world.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends, but one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends any more.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.
Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the seaside where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow.
Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains, there is a fantastic view, and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.
Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but it is so hard to choose the best pet.
Peppa and her friends are playing pirates, but when they put together a treasure chest and bury it in a marked spot, Pedro soon realises that he needs to follow the trail. He's lost something.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit Peppa and George. They are too excited to sleep. When Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig get home everyone is asleep.
Peppa and Luzie Locke find that adults have to work all the time. The children imitate the elders, in the shop and on the playground. They realise that playing can be really hard work.
Peppa and her friends learn how to count by playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.
Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.
George has fun making bubbles, and Peppa has fun popping them.
Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa can't see Leo, but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and playing dressing up.
It's Daddy Pig's birthday, but he has to go to work, so while he's away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George prepare a special birthday surprise.
Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.

Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check-up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and listens to Mummy tell him all about the changes Peppa has gone through.
Daddy Pig is left behind when everyone takes Grampy Rabbit's little boat to the riverside picnic spot. Will someone remember him and save him some cake?
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.
Peppa and George love helping Mummy Pig work on her computer, but they like playing computer games more.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.
Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. After a frenzy of cleaning, the room is tidy, but the room doesn't stay tidy for long though.
Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in too, which turns Daddy's shirt pink.
Doctor Hamster visits the school and brings some animals with her. Binky the Tortoise is very popular, but ends up needing to be rescued by Miss Rabbit.
Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.
The grass has grown so long that Peppa and George's ball gets lost in it. It falls to Grandpa to save the day with Betsy, his motorised lawnmower.
George pays a visit to Mr Fox's Shop after his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur, breaks. With all the additional features, surely Dino Roar is a good replacement?
It's fruit day at the market and Miss Rabbit is making smoothies from people's favourite fruit. She gives George a special 'dinosaur' juice to make him big and strong.
Peppa and George have fun in the snow, as they make footprints, snowballs and build a snowman.
Mummy Pig has a lovely new picture of Peppa and George, so Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but it's not as simple as Daddy Pig thought, and he makes a very big hole in the wall.
Goldie the fish does not look happy and is not eating her food. Peppa, George, and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the vet.

Peppa has a new pen pal, a little donkey from France named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
Granny Pig is really pleased with all the plastic gnomes and wishing well she's got for the garden. Peppa and George love them too, but Grandpa Pig wishes they would all disappear.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.

Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.

When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. It makes him realise that he misses the sea after all.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.

Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play at Peppa's house for the afternoon. Peppa won't allow George to join in. When Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is delighted to be the patient.
Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig. Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed until they are told a story.
Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo'.
Daddy teaches the children how to play basketball, and it is not long before they are good enough to take on a much bigger team.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it starts to get foggy, and before long it becomes so foggy that they can't see anything.

The Detective introduces his new friend, the superhero Super Potato, who teaches children the importance of eating fruit and vegetables every day, and later helps the Detective out of a complicated situation.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.
Everyone in Peppa's town is excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre.
Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles, but Mummy tells them to go in the pool instead.
Peppa and George take a bin of vegetable peelings to Grandpa Pig's compost heap. Worms inside the bin turn the peelings into compost, which Granny and Grandpa use to help their plants grow.
Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers.
Grandpa Pig is planting seeds to make a flower garden, but the birds keep eating them, so Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig to make a scarecrow, which stops the birds eating Grandpa's seeds.
Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall as he is selling some special items.
To celebrate Freddy Fox's birthday, the children go on a trip to a Dinosaur Park. With Grampy Rabbit as their leader, they follow dinosaur footprints to find Freddy's birthday treat.

Everyone is down at the lake as it's a perfect day to go boating. Miss Rabbit has all sorts of boats for hire and Daddy Pig picks one with pedals, but when all the families have a race, he soon wishes he had picked something easier to sail.
Grandpa Pig hides some pirate treasure in his garden, and when Peppa and George come, they have to look for it, using a map and following the clues.
When the family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner, George is reluctant to eat his salad.

After Peppa's tooth falls out, Mummy Pig explains that the Tooth Fairy will come that very night to take the tooth and leave a shiny coin in its place. Peppa plans to stay awake all night to see the Tooth Fairy.
Grandpa Pig pops round with some seeds for Peppa and George to plant, with Daddy Pig helping out by acting as a scarecrow.

Carly und ihre Freunde werden in das Büro von Daka eingeladen. Er schlägt ihnen ein Sponsorgeschäft vor. Wenn sie seine neuen Schuhe in der Sendung tragen, werden sie viel Geld dafür erhalten. Das einzige Problem: die Schuhe sehen schrecklich aus.

Carly braucht noch eine Eins in Geschichte, um die Bestnote in jedem Fach zu haben. Mr. Devlin findet ihren Text gut, gibt Carly aber nur eine Zwei Plus, da sie falsches Papier genutzt hat. Carly ist sehr enttäuscht und Sam versucht, ihr zu helfen.

Ein Fernsehsender sucht einen neuen Hit und stößt auf iCarly und erkennt das Potenzial. Er heuert das gesamte Team an, um im Fernsehen die Sendung zu produzieren, nimmt aber nach und nach Änderungen vor.

Sam ist in Jonah verknallt, doch der sorgt für jede Menge Probleme. Carly und Freddy gehen bald auf die Nerven, dass Sam kaum noch Zeit für iCarly hat. Als Carly mit Jonah darüber reden möchte, versucht er, sie zu küssen.

Carly wird für ein Stipendium an der Eliteschule Briarwood in Erwägung gezogen. Sie soll sich zu einem Gespräch mit der Rektorin Mrs. Peeloff treffen. Freddie und Sam befürchten, dass Carly sich bald nicht mehr mit ihnen abgibt.
Shannon steht auf Freddie. Gibby steht auf Shannon. Sam und Carly wollen Gibby helfen und veranstalten eine Spielshow. Gibby soll aus drei Mädchen eine finden, mit der er ein Date haben darf.

Carly und Sam verlieben sich beide in Freddies neuen Freund Shane und streiten um den ersten Kuss von ihm. Beide legen sich ordentlich ins Zeug, doch nach einem aufgeschnappten Gespräch und einem Vorfall mit dem Lift, sieht die Sache ganz anders aus.

Spencer soll eine Labradoodle-Skulptur für einen Kunden schaffen. Doch wird er rechtzeitig fertig werden, wenn er die ganze Zeit Pack Rat spielt? Carly und Sam treiben Sasha Striker auf, die den Pack-Rat-Weltrekord aufgestellt hat.

Freddie und Carly rechnen Sams Schulden bei ihnen vor: 526 Dollar. Sam gelobt, das Geld zurückzuzahlen, und bittet die Fans von iCarly um Geld. Dieses kommt säckeweise an, doch es ist rechtswidrig, Geld von Minderjährigen zu fordern.

Die hausgemachten Snacks von Sandy werden zum großen Erfolg in der Krossen Krabbe. SpongeBob und Patrick haben ein Lieblings-Comedy-Duo. Doch kommt es zwischen dem Duo vor der Kamera zu einem Streit, und sie sehen dabei zu.
SpongeBob feiert den Jahrestag der Freundschaft mit Thaddäus; Thaddäus muss zur Musikstunde.

SpongeBob ist frustriert, weil seine Freundin in den Salzigen Spucknapf durfte, er aber nicht. Jetzt muss er beweisen, dass er ein harter Junge ist. Squilliam ist mal wieder in Bikini Bottom und treibt Thaddäus zur Weißglut mit seinen Angebereien.

SpongeBob ist überzeugt, dass Mr. Krabs ein gefährlicher Roboter ist, der die Welt beherrschen will. Patrick und SpongeBob adoptieren eine kleine Baby-Muschel und müssen nun Eltern sein. Das macht erstmal Spaß, aber bald gibt es Streit.

SpongeBob und Patrick müssen das Wohnzimmer von Mr. Krabs mit wasserfester Farbe streichen. Mr. Krabs will seine Kundschaft in der Krossen Krabbe mit einem Trainingsvideo über Fastfood aufklären. Er sucht dabei auch nach neuen Mitarbeitern.

SpongeBob plant eine Hausparty und hat mithilfe eines Ratgebers alles perfekt vorbereitet. Doch dann feiern die Gäste ausgelassen, während er aus dem Haus ausgesperrt wurde. Aber es kommt noch viel schlimmer für den kleinen Schwamm.

Patrick und SpongeBob wollen etwas Geld verdienen und verkaufen Schokoladenriegel. Dabei erfinden sie Lügengeschichten. Blaubarschbube hat Meerjungfrauenmann satt und schließt sich lieber einer Gruppe Bösewichter an.

Der neue Mitschüler in SpongeBobs Fahrschule ist Patrick. Leider macht der ganz schön viele Fehler und die Freundschaft der beiden wird bald auf die Probe gestellt. Mr. Krabs feiert seinen Erfolg mit SpongeBob und Thaddäus beim Angeln.

Gary hilft SpongeBob dabei, "Nein" zu sagen, indem er ihm eine Scheuerschwammfläche zum Überziehen bestellt. SpongeBob hat außerdem einen Ohrwurm, den er immer wieder singt und der ihn langsam in den Wahnsinn treibt.

Dora und Boots helfen dem Drachen Dulce, fliegen zu lernen, damit sie zu ihren Eltern in die Wolkenhöhle kann. Die Körper von der Königin und Swiper werden durch die Magie des großen roten Huhns vertauscht. Dora und Boots helfen ihnen.
Tim und Tommy nehmen sich vor, zusammen einen möglichst großen Mondkürbis heranzuzüchten.
Tim und Tommy helfen in der Eiszeit-Stube aus und stellen sich neuen Aufgaben im Alltag.
Oma schenkt Tim einen selbstgemachten Hut, doch der erweist sich immer wieder als störend.

Watching reruns of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy. SpongeBob loses his self-confidence when an arrogant customer claims SpongeBob forgot to put pickles on his Krabby Patty.

Captain Charles Shore wird auf der Straße von einem Inder verfolgt. Kurz darauf fliegt ein Stein durch ein Fenster seines Hauses, wodurch einer seiner Söhne leichte Verletzungen erleidet. Daraufhin bittet sein Vater Sir Edward Shore den mittlerweile als privaten Ermittler arbeitenden Mr. Whicher um Hilfe. Als der Verfolger von Charles tot aufgefunden wird, eskalieren die Ereignisse.
Murdoch entwickelt ein Elixier, das jugendliche Vitalität zurückbringt. Crabtree beunruhigt das.

Auf den Bankangestellten Mr. Shaw werden mehrere Anschläge verübt. Eigentlich sollte er Anleihen im Wert von einer Million Dollar nach New York bringen, doch nun übernimmt sein Kollege Philip Ridgeway den Transport auf der Queen Mary.

Als Poirot von Hastings dazu überredet wird, ihn auf einen Maskenball zur Feier des englischen Siegs im Krieg zu begleiten, ist er zunächst wenig begeistert. Aber wider Erwarten ist an diesem Abend Poirots kriminalistischer Spürsinn gefragt.

Nach ihrer Heirat mit Derek entdeckt Ursula dessen düstere Seite. Als ein Ehestreit tödlich endet, macht sie in ihrem nächsten Leben einige Dinge anders. Ein Job als Lehrerin führt sie nach Deutschland, wo der Zweite Weltkrieg näher rückt.

In mehreren weiteren Leben bekommt Ursula das Grauen des Krieges zu spüren. Sie begeht Selbstmord, um den Verlauf der Geschichte zu verändern. Ihr Weg führt sie abermals nach Deutschland, wo sie Adolf Hitler töten möchte.

Leonard beteuert, dass alles nur ein Missverständnis ist, doch Pauline glaubt ihm nicht. Als Leonard auf Coco trifft, beschwört er sie, dass Patrizia ihn in eine Falle gelockt hat. Als Coco ein gutes Wort für Leonard einlegt, ist Pauline verwirrt. Patrizia weiß indes nicht weiter. Barbara erweist sich als wohlwollende Schwester, indem sie Leonards Zweifel an Patrizias Aufrichtigkeit zerstreut. Leonard entschuldigt sich bei Patrizia.

Werner erfährt von Cocos Kündigung und reibt Friedrich den Unfrieden im "Fürstenhof" unter die Nase. Friedrich macht Werner daraufhin klar, dass dieser ihm keine Ansagen machen kann, ohne Anteile am "Fürstenhof" zu besitzen. Seinen Frust darüber lässt Werner an Barbara aus, die gerade auf dem Weg ins Krankenhaus ist. Als sie vor seinen Augen zusammenbricht, muss er erkennen, dass er sich getäuscht hat. Barbara bietet Werner für seinen Kampf um den "Fürstenhof" eine Million Euro an.

Auch wenn es Pauline schwerfällt, beschließt sie, ihr Brautkleid dem Kirchenbasar zu spenden. Pauline scheint mit sich im Reinen. Martin wundert sich, dass Friedrich beim Gedenkgottesdienst auftaucht. Obwohl seine Predigt keinerlei kompromittierende Aussagen enthält, stört Friedrich die Andacht auf blasphemische Art und Weise. Martin nimmt die Ignoranz und Unkenntnis seines Vaters hinsichtlich der Kirche persönlich.

Im Mittelpunkt stehen die emotionalen Liebes- und Familiengeschichten rund um das Personal und die Eigentümer des Luxushotels "Fürstenhof". Der Alltag wird bestimmt von tragischen Schicksalsschlägen, gemeinen Intrigen und turbulenten Liebschaften.

Klara Degen findet den Sternekoch Dollberg tot auf, ausgerechnet, als ein Hollywood-Star in seinem Restaurant essen will. Die Ermittlungen beginnen sofort. Schnell wird klar, dass Dollberg sehr unbeliebt war. Ein richtiger Tyrann, der die Frauen belästigt und die Männer herumkommandiert hat. Nur die Serviceleiterin Gerlinde Sieverding trägt Trauer. Klara Degen folgt ihrer Intuition und befragt im Auftrag von ihrem Chef die junge und attraktive Patisseuse Melanie Franke.

Klara Degen, die mutige Sekretärin der Kripo Harz, geht nach Feierabend mit ihrem Kollegen Tom Ollenhauer zu einer UFO-Wiese. Hier wurden in den letzten Wochen unbekannte Flugobjekte beobachtet. An dem Sichtungsplatz herrscht Trubel, sogar einen Bratwurststand gibt es. Und das Warten hat sich tatsächlich gelohnt: Über dem dunklen Wald erhebt sich ein unheimlicher Lichtkegel. Klara und Olli schauen fasziniert in den Himmel, als es im Wald einen lauten Knall gibt.

Da Nora den Job nicht bekommen hat, möchte sie unbedingt einen Buchladen eröffnen. Simone bietet ihr gute Mietkonditionen an, möchte die Vertragsunterzeichnung aber medial ausschlachten, was Nora ablehnt. Merle muss sich nach ihrer Augen-OP schonen. Carla wirft Henri aus der Küche, doch Theo bringt ihn dazu mehr für seine Träume zu kämpfen. Torben und Hannes schlagen sich derweil durch die Wälder und machen einen Survival-Probelauf für Patagonien.

Lasse bietet Nora seine Wohnung an, weil ihr Campingbus, indem sie schlief, abgeschleppt wurde. Carla ist pikiert, weil Henri das Praktikum ablehnt und lieber in einer Kantine anfangen will. Thomas ärgert sich über Simone, die seine Flüchtlingspolitik und den Zuzug weiterer Asylbewerber torpediert. Simone geht mit populistischen Parolen auf Stimmenfang und will eine eigene Partei gründen. Eliane ist frustriert, weil die Konkurrenz ihre Kunden abwirbt.

Voller Vorfreude erwartet Hans-Peter Brenner seine Mutter Luise von der Kur zurück. Sie wirkt sehr angespannt. Als der Pfleger seinen Dienst antritt, fährt er beinahe mit dem Fahrrad einen ankommenden Patienten über den Haufen: Richard Wissler. Dieser hat Flüssigkeit zwischen Lunge und Brustwand und muss punktiert werden, wie Dr. Martin Stein feststellt.

Sarah Marquardt ist im Glück: Mit dem Rechtsanwalt Benjamin Wittenberg hat sie offenbar einen Volltreffer gelandet. Ein großer Strauß roter Rosen wartet auf sie, als sie morgens in der Klinik eintrifft. Allerdings gibt es ein winziges Problem in der aufkeimenden Liebesbeziehung - noch hat sie keine Gelegenheit gefunden, Benjamin zu beichten, dass sie keine Ärztin ist.

Jasper unterstellt der Cheftierärztin Medikamentenmissbrauch. Deshalb versucht er, Susanne auf sie anzusetzen. Doch Susanne will sich nicht zu Jaspers Spitzel machen lassen. Trotzdem lässt sich nicht verhindern, dass sie nun etwas genauer hinsieht.

Die Zusammenarbeit von Susanne und der Cheftierärztin wird immer besser. Sie respektieren einander und schätzen die Kompetenzen der anderen. Nach der Operation am Schneeleoparden gibt es sogar einen freundschaftlichen Moment zwischen den beiden.

Julia Klug kehrt zurück nach Berlin. Gezwungenermaßen. Hoch verschuldet, weil einem Betrüger auf den Leim gegangen, muss sie mit Baby Ellie wieder bei ihren nichtsahnenden Eltern unterschlüpfen, zurück nach Hause, von wo sie vor 13 Jahren regelrecht geflohen war. Es kommt für Julia noch schlimmer: Die SEK-erfahrene Elitepolizistin muss ab jetzt ausgerechnet im Betrugsdezernat der Polizeidirektion 7 arbeiten.

Die verzweifelte Claudia Prinz will sich in die Spree stürzen. Sie ist auf einen Heiratsschwindler hereingefallen, der sie nicht nur betrogen, sondern obendrein um 10.000 Euro erleichtert hat. Für Julia Klug, die ja selber Opfer eines Heiratsschwindlers wurde, ist klar: Dieser Betrüger - er nennt sich Costa Schettino - muss zur Strecke gebracht werden! Ihr Chef Johannes Sonntag sieht das ganz anders: So ein Fall gehört in einen Groschenroman - nicht in die Zuständigkeit des Betrugsdezernats.

Theo und Henri lassen die Wäsche des Hotels verschwinden, um Elianes Konkurrenz auszustechen. Als Eliane davon Wind bekommt, ist sie entsetzt. Nur unter Protest macht Lasse weiter mit, Johanna eine Männer-WG mit Thomas vorzugaukeln. Dank Nora kommt Johanna jedoch dahinter, dass ihr Sohn diese Lüge benutzt, um nicht mit ihr zusammenwohnen zu müssen, wofür sie sich rächt. Wegen dieses WG-Spielchens kommt Lasse zu spät, um Nora im Kiosk abzulösen und ihren Campingbus auszulösen.

Simone attackiert weiterhin Thomas' Flüchtlingspolitik. Als Erika überfallen wird, macht Simone Stimmung gegen die Asylbewerber. Thomas greift mithilfe eines Fotos, das Torben gemacht hat, zu einem Bluff. Wird sein Plan aufgehen und Simone freiwillig den Stadtrat verlassen? Nora wird nicht schlau aus Lasse. Einerseits ist er sehr hilfsbereit, wenn es um eine Duschmöglichkeit im Rosenhaus geht, andererseits verweigert er ihr seinen Computer für ihre Jobsuche.

Simon und André plagt das schlechte Gewissen, als sie erfahren, dass Werner Viktoria gekündigt hat. Charlotte weist Werner in die Schranken, der daraufhin vor Wut kocht. Rosalie und Ben küssen sich. Simon ist nicht gut auf Evelyn zu sprechen.

Rosalie verschweigt ihre massiven Geldprobleme. Als Emma sich eine neue Nähmaschine kaufen will, ist ihr Konto nicht gedeckt. Evelyns Annäherungsversuch scheitert. Johann will auswandern. Charlotte und Werner entzweien sich zunehmend.

Sie begannen mit einem aufsehenerregenden Skandal, machten ihre Liebe, die gegenseitige Anziehung, ihren Streit, den Reichtum und ihre Süchte öffentlich und wurden so zum Glamourpaar der Swinging Sixties: Elizabeth Taylor und Richard Burton. Sie ist seit ihrer Kindheit ein verwöhnter Hollywoodstar, er ist ein walisischer Bergarbeitersohn, der sich zu einem der großen Theatermimen seines Landes entwickelt hatte. Sie begegnen sich am Filmset in Rom.

Nach einem Streit wird Alfie, Bewohner von Leonards 'Half Way House', tot aufgefunden. Geordie ermittelt wegen Mordes unter den Mitbewohnern, trotz vorgetäuschten Suizids. Will plagen Schuldgefühle, weil er Alfie vor dessen Tod nicht zuhörte.

Ein scheinbar einfacher Fall entwickelt sich zu einem komplexen Geflecht aus Täuschung und internationaler Intrige: Zwei Männer werden vergiftet, einer von ihnen stirbt - doch schnell stellt sich die Frage.

Will wird nach einem Unfall von Polizist Mac gerettet. Geordie und Will geraten in einen Mordfall an einem Bauernpaar, bei dem Verwandte verdächtig sind. Will wird entführt und entdeckt die Wahrheit. Leonard wird von Elliot schikaniert.

Nach dem tragischen Tod ihres Sohnes an einer Überdosis macht die texanische Kirchenchorleiterin Maybelline sich auf den Weg nach San Francisco. Dort überrascht sie alle, indem sie ihr Erbe antritt und den Drag-Club ihres Sohnes übernimmt. Das Lokal steht kurz vor dem finanziellen Ruin, doch Maybelline lässt nichts unversucht, um es zu retten. Dabei helfen ihr der Freund und die beste Freundin ihres Sohnes.
Almost four decades after her father's death, Lady Irene Hatter embarks on a journey to find out the truth behind her father's bravery.

Paul travels by puffer to explore a little known string of islands just off the west coast by Oban. First landfall is the Island of Kerrera, which Paul discovers played a hugely important role during the Second World War.

Dr Suzannah Lipscomb explores the time when British people embraced modern design for the first time after years of austerity and self-denial. The look and feel of the post-war home, had its roots in the materials discovered during World War Two.

Der ab 1937 geführte Konflikt im Pazifik weitet sich dramatisch zum Weltkrieg aus. Nach dem verheerenden Angriff Japans auf Pearl Harbor am 7. Dezember 1941 geben die bisher neutralen Vereinigten Staaten ihre Zurückhaltung endgültig auf.

Es wird erläutert, warum die USA einen Wendepunkt im Pazifikkrieg herbeiführen konnten. Im Jahre 1942 entschlüsselten die USA das geheime Code-System der Japaner und konnten ihnen dadurch einen erheblichen Schaden zuführen.

Erklärt wird, wie die USA es geschafft haben, den Pazifikkrieg zu ihren Gunsten zu beenden. Um Japan zum endgültigen Aufgeben zu bewegen, griffen die USA auf eine neue Waffe mit unvorhergesehener Zerstörungskraft zurück.

Deutschland, Indien, Äthiopien sind drei Länder mit drei Ausgangslagen und derselben Herausforderung: Klimawandel. Und doch könnten die Strategien unterschiedlicher kaum sein. Deutschland ringt um die Transformation seiner Industrie, Indien um Wachstum und steigenden Energiebedarf. Äthiopien hat die Klimakrise kaum verursacht, spürt ihre Folgen aber schon heute. Wie begegnen diese drei Länder den Herausforderungen durch den Klimawandel?

Die zwei Gepardenmütter Chilli und Inara treffen aufeinander und vermischen ihre Jungen. Das Besondere dabei ist, dass Chilli die Mutter von Inara ist. Etwas Unvorhergesehenes passiert, denn Inara säugt die fremden Welpen und rettet damit ihr Leben.

Der Hudson River ist rund 500 km lang und entspringt am Mount Marcy, dem höchsten Berg des Bundesstaates New York. Tausende Hektar ungezähmter Lebensraum, Wälder, Sandbänke, Sümpfe, Wasserfälle und Seen bieten unzähligen Tierarten Unterschlupf.

Paris im Jahr 1899: Der mittellose Schriftsteller Christian soll für den legendären Nachtclub Moulin Rouge ein Theaterstück schreiben. Die Hauptrolle soll der Star des Moulin Rouge übernehmen: Satine. Um die finanziellen Mittel des Theaterstücks zu sichern, soll Satine den reichen Duke verführen. Durch eine Verwechslung hält sie jedoch Christian für den Duke und verliebt sich in ihn. Als sie ihren Irrtum erkennt, steht sie vor einer schwierigen Entscheidung: entweder ihr Traum oder die Liebe.

Der Ingenieur Gustave Eiffel ist vor der Pariser Weltausstellung des Jahres 1889 auf der Suche nach Inspiration. Denn die Regierung will, dass er etwas Spektakuläres konstruiert, was die internationalen Besucher zum Staunen bringen wird. Als Eiffel auf seine frühere mysteriöse Geliebte Adrienne Bourgès trifft, beflügelt diese seine Fantasie. Er will ihr ein unsterbliches Monument errichten. Daraufhin entsteht zwischen 1887 und 1889 der Eiffelturm, das Wahrzeichen der Stadt.

Tarek und Christina kaufen ein Haus in Long Beach, Kalifornien. Da es noch bewohnt ist, ist eine Besichtigung nicht möglich. Dadurch entsteht ein Risiko, doch die beiden Makler haben reichlich Erfahrung und können dieses einschätzen.

Obwohl Rick und Rita ihr Traumhaus immer noch lieben, müssen sie einsehen, dass es mittlerweile einige Modernisierungen benötigt. Jenn soll daher die gesamte Inneneinrichtung renovieren, während das Pärchen im Urlaub ist.

Georgia und Richie verwandeln Stacy und Bens Haus in Montrose. Sie ändern den Grundriss, schaffen einen Eltern-Rückzugsort und vergrößern die Küche. Mit mutigen Farben und afrikanischem Flair entsteht ein Traumhaus für das weltoffene Paar.

Christina und Josh ziehen mit den Kindern in ein neues Zuhause, während Christina und James wieder als Design-Duo starten. Ihr erstes Projekt ist es, eine enge Küche und ein kleines Esszimmer in einen offenen Raum zum Entspannen zu verwandeln.

Monica kauft sich ständig teure Schuhe und Chandler ist deswegen sauer auf sie. Phoebe will einen Streit von Ben, Ross' Sohn, mit einem anderen Schüler schlichten. Sie erhofft sich dadurch Karten für das Konzert von Sting.

Mona fragt Ross, was für eine Beziehung sie haben und Ross ist überhaupt nicht begeistert. Denn er möchte nicht darüber reden, sondern einfach machen. Doch damit kommt er bei Mona überhaupt nicht gut an. Rachel ist schwanger und denkt nur an Sex.

Ein Spielautomat sorgt bei Phoebe, Monica und Chandler für aufkommendes Spielfieber. Rachel hatte seit Beginn ihrer Schwangerschaft keine Verabredungen mehr und sie ist deswegen traurig. Joey hat sich in Rachel verliebt.

Chandler genießt gern ein Vollbad und ist der Kapitän der Badewanne. Monica sagt ihm, dass das gar nicht unmännlich ist. Rachel und Ross können sich nicht einigen, was für ihr zukünftiges Kind das Beste ist.

Als Catherine Avery ins Seattle Grace kommt, um eine Transplantation durchzuführen, geben die Assistenzärzte ihr Bestes, um sie zu beeindrucken. Arizona und Alex behandeln einen bekannten Patienten in der Notaufnahme.

Nachdem Meredith von den meisten Chirurgen ausgeschlossen wird, nutzt sie Lexie, um Derek auf eine Patientin mit einem seltenen Gehirntumor aufmerksam zu machen. Außerdem steht sie April zur Seite, als diese Hilfe bei Baileys Studie braucht.
Richard erholt sich von seiner Bypass-Operation und Rory kehrt nach Yale zurück. Indes soll Lorelai die Begräbnisfeier für Michels kürzlich verblichenes Hündchen organisieren.

Richard erholt sich langsam von seiner Herzoperation. Doch die verordnete Ruhe und vor allem das Diätessen wirken sich auf seine Laune aus. Emily ist verzweifelt. Nicht nur geht ihr Richard auf die Nerven, sie scheitert auch bei dem Versuch, die Steuererklärung abzuschließen. Lorelai schreitet helfend ein und nutzt den Augenblick, um Emily über ihre Trennung von Christopher zu unterrichten.

Lorelai organisiert eine Babyparty für Lane, während Rory ein lang ersehntes Bewerbungsgespräch wahrnimmt. Nach ihrer Rückkehr berichtet Logan endlich von dem Fiasko in seiner Firma. Rory ist enttäuscht, dass er seine Probleme so lange verschwiegen hat und wütend, dass er mit zwei Kumpels nach Vegas fährt, um sich von seinen Sorgen abzulenken. Luke erkennt, dass er etwas wagen muss, um positiv in die Zukunft blicken zu können.

Lorelai erhält eine Einladung zur Hochzeit von Mia, die ihr in der Vergangenheit mit mütterlichem Rat zur Seite gestanden hatte. Nach einem heftigen Streit mit Logan entschließt sich auch Rory dazu, an den Feierlichkeiten teilzunehmen. Begleitet werden die beiden von Emily, deren Verhältnis zu Mia nicht unbelastet ist.

Owen meldet das Krankenhaus bei einer Softball-Liga an, sodass es zu einem Match gegen einen verhassten Konkurrenten kommt. Unterdessen hat Lexie Schwierigkeiten, ihre Eifersucht im Zaum zu halten, als sie Mark mit einer anderen Frau sieht.

Die Ärzte werden sehr wehmütig, als George O'Malleys Mutter Louise aus medizinischen Gründen im Seattle Grace erscheint. Sie hatte eine Operation in einem benachbarten Krankenhaus, die jedoch vermasselt wurde.

Carlos und Gabrielle treffen ihre leibliche Tochter Grace. Graces Adoptivmutter ist nicht begeistert von Gabrielle. Paul kauft sich sein Haus wieder zurück. Nun will er auch das Haus von Mrs. McCluskey kaufen.

Susans Job steht auf der Kippe, als sie einen wichtigen Kunden verärgert und damit die Wut ihrer Chefin Maxine auf sich zieht. Derweil kommt es zu einem Streit zwischen Gaby und Renée, da beide Geheimnisse der jeweils anderen preisgegeben haben.
Paul und Beth besuchen einen Therapeuten, der Paul Beziehungstipps gibt. Als Beth ihn trotzdem wieder abweist, setzt er ihr ein Ultimatum.

Lynette erhält ein verführerisches Jobangebot von Renée, während sie Susan als neues Kindermädchen für Baby Paige einstellt. Bree muss sich eingestehen, dass sie durch ihre Menopause geht und hat Probleme damit, es Keith zu erzählen, während sich Gaby um Bobs Verhalten gegenüber Carlos sorgt. Beth setzt hingegen alles daran, herauszufinden, was Paul für dunkle Pläne schmiedet.

Am Tatort machen Castle und Beckett eine schockierende Entdeckung denn das Opfer gleicht der Gerichtsmedizinerin aufs Haar. Das Team vermutet einen gezielten Angriff auf das Revier und eine unheimliche Ärztin gerät ins Visier der Ermittler.

Ein sterbender Mann übergibt einem Priester ein kleines Baby bevor er leblos in der Kirche zusammenbricht. Für Castle und Beckett beginnt ein emotionaler Fall denn sie müssen den Mörder finden und die wahren Eltern des Kindes aufspüren.

Jane hat ein Problem: Der Killer Red John entwischt ihm immer wieder. Jetzt weiß er sogar schon die Namen derer, die Jane für Red John hält. Woher kann er das nur wissen? Keiner hat eine Ahnung. Ein neuer Fall beschäftigt das CBI.

Auf der Churchill Road explodiert ein Wagen. Der Fahrer ist sofort tot. Ermittlungen ergeben, dass der Mann bei einer Drohnen-Entwicklungsfirma gearbeitet hatte und an einem Projekt namens "Redbird" beteiligt gewesen war.

Sherlock ermittelt im Fall einer Frauenleiche, die nach einem alten Ritual mumifiziert werden sollte. Der flüchtige Täter ist kein Einzeltäter. Nach dem Tod seines Bruders versucht Sherlock, das Verhältnis zu seinem Vater wieder aufzubauen.

Gilbert Pham ist Vertragsanwalt, doch nach der Fusion zweier Tabakkonzerne wird er tot aufgefunden. Die Ermittlungen ergeben, dass Gilbert Pham illegalen Machenschaften auf die Spur gekommen ist. Sherlock und Joan geraten in ein gefährliches Spiel.

Brixham's glory days get relived with a nostalgic heritage festival and vintage ships race. On a more downbeat note, a local toy store owner faces making a very difficult decision.

Chuck and Prince venture upstate to rub elbows with a new political force. Prince sacrifices pride to do a personal favour. Wendy helps Wags unpack his deepest desires.

In Seattle, Ellie and Dina find themselves amid a brutal battle between the zealous Seraphites and a ruthless militia.

Camp Crystal Lake reopens for the summer despite the mounting death toll. Tensions rise as Levon and Dorf clash over the murder suspects. Pam, worried she is losing Grace to the new staff, discovers troubling news that changes everything.

Lawyer Charlie Quinn finds herself at a school during a shooting, which resurfaces traumatic memories. Charlie's father, representing the accused, tasks her with finding the shooter's mum. Charlie takes Rusty home, then gets a frantic call.

The Terminal Islanders return home to find that things have changed since they left; the Nakayamas, still tense from the pain they've inflicted on one another, must come together to battle the spirit that threatens their future.
Loose-cannon cops Lowrey and Burnett reduce Miami to rubble as they try to stop Cuban and Russian drug smugglers from flooding Florida with ecstasy.

On a remote island, a wealthy entrepreneur creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening the attraction to the public, he invites a top palaeontologist, palaeobotanist, mathematician/theorist, and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park. Their park visit is anything but tranquil as the park's security system breaks down, and the prehistoric creatures break out.

Michael Portillo crosses the Culloden Viaduct aboard the Caledonian Sleeper to arrive bright and early in the coastal city of Inverness, from which he heads north on a scenic adventure to the Orkney archipelago. On boggy moorland overlooking the Moray Firth near Inverness, Michael explores the battlefield at Culloden, where Bonnie Prince Charlie's Jacobite army fought British government troops in 1746.

It's the last trip before Christmas and, with demand surging, fish prices are rising. Off the south coast of Cornwall, Ocean Pride is heading out in pursuit of pollock among the old sunken shipwrecks of the English Channel. 380 miles away on the Yorkshire coast, crabber Tydus is preparing to head out with hopes of a big pay day. The aim is to put six tons in the tank, a catch that this week could fetch well over £30,000.

Michael Aspel and the team are in Rochdale's magnificent town hall. Amongst the objects under scrutiny are a gold pencil gifted by King George IV, paintbrushes used by LS Lowry, and the diaries of a British hangman.
Members of the public try to make money out of their antiques by taking a risk at auction.

Every day this week, celebrity contestants Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player?
Ellie Taylor digs into all the weekend's action with her all-star panel, and the latest couple to be eliminated from the competition is on the sofa for an exclusive chat about their time on Strictly.

Bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories.
Dave and Owen bust a city centre drug dealer carrying cash and cocaine. The vehicle crime team chase a careless driver, and officers separating a street brawl face a torrent of abuse.
BBC Eye reveals new evidence showing how scouts, agencies and powerful fashion figures helped Jeffrey Epstein gain access to young women after his conviction for sex offences.

Mrs Marrable is a bereaved widow who takes to hiring housekeepers and then killing them for their money. When Miss Tinsley disappears, her former employer Alice investigates. Posing as a maid, she gains employment with the murderous Mrs Marrable.
A TOTP-style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

During World War II, an Italian village finds itself caught in the bloody struggle between retreating Nazi forces, stubborn fascists, local partisans and the incoming U.S. forces. A group of villagers, including love-struck Galvano and his dream girl, Concetta, opt to leave their village and search for American troops. The story, set in part during a Tuscan celebration, is told from the point of view of 6-year-old Cecilia.

An American airman who inherits an English earldom goes to England with two friends to see if he likes it enough to accept it. Whether or not the American can cope with English nobility is another matter.
Upon Marian's pleas, Robin attempts to stop Prince John from divorcing his wife and marrying a French lady.

Doctor Beaker and the Supercar team are invited to join an underwater exploration of an ancient temple. As their plans progress, locals warn them not to dive on the site, or there will be consequences.

One-armed detective Mark Saber, an Englishman working with the New York Police Department, along with his assistant, Sergeant Tim Moloney, tracks down criminals by his brilliant use of deduction as well as regular police methods.
Conway woos a gunman's girlfriend, hoping she'll lead him to the fugitive.
A Manhattan bootlegger courts a woman who has been flirting with his right-hand man.
When an Englishman leaves America to enlist in the RAF, his gruelling combat experiences result in a loss of memory.
The hunt for Skinner's murderer has moved away from Newtown. So why is a London detective on his way there, in secret?
A woman investigates the possibility that her husband's death in a plane crash was no accident.

The Queen's young cousin, who has come to England to learn his knightly duties, falls in with evil companions and is persuaded to take part in an audacious plot.
As the Germans drop explosive booby-traps on Britain in 1943, the embittered explosives expert who will have to disarm them fights an ever-increasing private battle with alcoholism.

Despite his guilt over a recent harrowing sea battle in which many of his men were lost, Lt Commander George Ericson is assigned to helm the new HMS Compass Rose with the help of steadfast seaman Lt Lockhart. When the small vessel is sent to escort convoys of ships fighting German U-boats in the North Atlantic, the mettle of the novice crew is tested by the weather, the turbulent sea and enemy attacks, one of which nearly destroys the Compass Rose.
The Thunderbirds team provide information and statistics on road traffic accidents and provide some safety tips for children.
When a member of parliament commits suicide, his son seeks the author of the book that triggered the tragedy.
Take a glorious trip back to Lancashire in 1948... to celebrate bleach, then let's cycle back to the 50s, and remember to bring your wheelbarrows - there's a new way to make a bob or two!

Just once, the inexhaustible Commissioner Maigret treats himself to a few days of rest in the south of France, but the appearance of a dead body and the disappearance of a wealthy art dealer interrupt his holiday.

José Chebec's body is discovered in a dinghy floating near Fort Boyard. Twenty years earlier, he committed a break-in which went wrong, and was jailed, but his accomplice was never found. Solène Brach, heading the investigation, must deal with the island's uncooperative mayor.
Ethan Hunt and the IMF team race against time to find the Entity, a rogue artificial intelligence that can destroy mankind.
After being branded a traitor following a disastrous mission in Prague, an elite intelligence agent recruits a team of operatives to help him retrieve a computer disk that can clear his name.
IMF agent Ethan Hunt is sent to Sydney to find and destroy a genetically modified disease called Chimera after a rogue colleague kills the diseases creator and makes off with the remedy.

NSA Agent Augustus Gibbons, fresh off the success of his last renegade recruitment, once again finds himself in need of an outsider. Gibbons and his new agent must track a dangerous military splinter group that is conspiring to overthrow the US Government in the nation's capital.

Dumped and depressed, English rose Iris agrees to swap homes with similarly unlucky in love Californian Amanda for a much-needed break. Iris finds herself in a palatial Hollywood mansion while Amanda navigates the lanes of a picture-perfect English village. Soon enough, both lovelorn ladies bump into local lads perfect for a romantic pick-me-up.
An ex-con's plan to pose as his late cellmate backfires when he is roped into a casino heist on Christmas Eve.

One happy couple; four dysfunctional, divorced parents who all insist on celebrating with their kids; a single, well-planned, happy day quickly spins out of control into the madcap whirlwind of Four Christmases.
When four generations of the Cooper clan come together for their annual Christmas Eve celebration, a series of unexpected visitors and unlikely events turn the night upside down.

A gadget salesman is looking for a special gift for his son and finds one at a store in Chinatown. The shopkeeper is reluctant to sell him the 'mogwai' but sells it to him with the warning to never expose him to bright light, water, or to feed him after midnight. All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve.

A primary school teacher, who was once a failed actor in a former career, is given the task of directing the school's Nativity play, which doesn't have a positive track record. Attitudes change, however, when it transpires that a Hollywood producer is coming to film the play.

Paul Edgecomb, the head guard of death row, just wants life for him, his colleagues and the condemned to be nice and easy.
